prove coercivity of the paper's concrete form and is not the paper's Lemma 1.1.

    coercive.continuousLinearEquivOfBilin_apply⟩

section ComplexDual

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]

/- The dual-norm results need only a complex normed space, so they apply in
particular to every complete complex Hilbert space from the checklist. -/

/-- The convention used in this file is the complex-linear evaluation pairing.

If an analytic integral is conjugate-linear in its test vector, it must first be
transported to a conjugate space or conjugated; it may not silently be identified
with this pairing.
-/
noncomputable def dualPairing (f : StrongDual ℂ E) (v : E) : ℂ :=
  f v

@[simp]

declarations.name: dualPairing_apply
declarations.header:
theorem dualPairing_apply (f : StrongDual ℂ E) (v : E) :
    dualPairing f v = f v :=
  rfl

@[simp]

declarations.name: dualPairing_zero
declarations.header: theorem dualPairing_zero (f : StrongDual ℂ E) : dualPairing f 0 = 0:=

declarations.name: dualPairing_add
declarations.header:
theorem dualPairing_add (f : StrongDual ℂ E) (u v : E) :
    dualPairing f (u + v) = dualPairing f u + dualPairing f v:=

declarations.name: dualPairing_smul
declarations.header:
theorem dualPairing_smul (f : StrongDual ℂ E) (c : ℂ) (v : E) :
    dualPairing f (c • v) = c * dualPairing f v:=

declarations.header:
theorem dualPairing_zero_functional (v : E) :
    dualPairing (0 : StrongDual ℂ E) v = 0:=

declarations.name: dualPairing_add_functional
declarations.header:
theorem dualPairing_add_functional (f g : StrongDual ℂ E) (v : E) :

declarations.header:

declarations.header:
theorem dual_holder_complex (f : StrongDual ℂ E) (v : E) :
    ‖dualPairing f v‖ ≤ ‖f‖ * ‖v‖ :=
  f.le_opNorm v

/-- Pointwise quotient form of the operator-norm bound.

Mathlib defines division by zero, so the statement is true even at `v = 0`;
the supremum sets below nevertheless exclude `v = 0` to match the paper.
-/

declarations.name: dual_ratio_le
declarations.header:
theorem dual_ratio_le (f : StrongDual ℂ E) (v : E) :
    ‖dualPairing f v‖ / ‖v‖ ≤ ‖f‖ :=
  f.ratio_le_opNorm v

/-! ### Unit-sphere form -/

/-- Norms of evaluations on the unit sphere. -/
def dualUnitEvalSet (f : StrongDual ℂ E) : Set ℝ :=
  (fun v : E => ‖dualPairing f v‖) '' Metric.sphere 0 1

/-- Complex-linear abstract analogue of Proposition 1, equation (1.3), in
unit-sphere form.

This theorem also handles a subsingleton domain: then the unit sphere is empty,
Mathlib has `sSup (∅ : Set ℝ) = 0`, and every functional has norm zero.
-/

declarations.name: dual_norm_eq_sSup_unit
declarations.header:
theorem dual_norm_eq_sSup_unit (f : StrongDual ℂ E) :
    ‖f‖ = sSup (dualUnitEvalSet f):=

declarations.header:

/-! ## 4. Unconditional paper-statement correction and obstruction layer

The declarations in this section do two different jobs, and their names keep
the distinction explicit.

* `UnitaryAutomorphyFactor`, the anti-dual layer, weak equations, dense-core
  extension, and the corrected lower/upper crossover lemma are reusable
  positive interfaces.
* Declarations whose names contain `counterexample`, `not_`, `forces`, or
  `obstruction` are kernel-checked proofs that the corresponding source-paper
  inference cannot be used as stated.

None of the structures below packages an unproved theorem as an axiom. A
field of a structure is input data, so a concrete application is certified
only after an inhabitant is constructed for the paper's actual objects.
-/

/-- A form together with an exposed proof that it is coercive at the fixed
constant `α`.  This subtype makes the high-level solver read `solve B F`
without hiding either `α` or the coercivity proof in an axiom or typeclass. -/
abbrev CoerciveSesquilinearFormWith (α : ℝ) (V : Type*)
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℂ V] :=
  {B : ContinuousSesquilinearForm V // ComplexCoerciveWith α B}

/-! #### A small reusable real Lax--Milgram solver -/

section RealLaxMilgramCore

variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
variable [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The real Lax--Milgram solution obtained by composing the inverse
Lax--Milgram equivalence with the real Riesz representative of `f`. -/
noncomputable def realLaxMilgramSolve
    (B : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hB : IsCoercive B)
    (f : H →L[ℝ] ℝ) : H :=
  hB.continuousLinearEquivOfBilin.symm
    ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H).symm f)

declarations.name: realLaxMilgramSolve_spec
declarations.header:
theorem realLaxMilgramSolve_spec
    (B : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hB : IsCoercive B)
    (f : H →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : H) :
    B (realLaxMilgramSolve B hB f) v = f v:=

    (f : H →L[ℝ] ℝ) {u : H} (hu : ∀ v, B u v = f v) :
    u = realLaxMilgramSolve B hB f:=

declarations.name: solveShifted_existsUnique
declarations.header:
theorem solveShifted_existsUnique (α : ℝ)
    (B mass : ContinuousSesquilinearForm V) (lam : ℝ)
    (hShift : ComplexCoerciveWith α (shiftedForm B mass lam))
    (F : StrongAntiDual V) :
    ∃! u : V, ∀ v,
      B u v + (lam : ℂ) * mass u v = F v:=

declarations.name: solveShifted_norm_le
declarations.header:
theorem solveShifted_norm_le (α : ℝ)
    (B mass : ContinuousSesquilinearForm V) (lam : ℝ)
    (hShift : ComplexCoerciveWith α (shiftedForm B mass lam))
    (F : StrongAntiDual V) :
    ‖solveShifted α B mass lam hShift F‖ ≤ α⁻¹ * ‖F‖:=

declarations.name: solveRieszShifted_spec
declarations.header:
theorem solveRieszShifted_spec (α : ℝ)
    (B : ContinuousSesquilinearForm V) (lam : ℝ)

    (F : StrongAntiDual V) (v : V) :
    B (solveShifted α B rieszMassForm lam hShift F) v +
        (lam : ℂ) * ⟪v, solveShifted α B rieszMassForm lam hShift F⟫_ℂ =
      F v:=

declarations.name: ker_eq_bot
declarations.header:
theorem ker_eq_bot (hA : HasTrivialKernel A) : A.ker = ⊥ :=

declarations.name: injective

section SesquilinearCuspTail

variable {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℂ V]

/-- Pointwise two-variable tail estimates strong enough to imply convergence
in the operator norm of sesquilinear forms.  A concrete modular-surface proof
must provide both compact core truncations and the uniform cusp estimate. -/
structure SesquilinearCuspTailControl
    (C : ContinuousSesquilinearForm V) where

declarations.name: tail_opNorm_le
declarations.header:
theorem tail_opNorm_le
    (h : SesquilinearCuspTailControl C) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖h.truncation n - C‖ ≤ h.epsilon n:=

declarations.name: tail_norm_tendsto_zero
declarations.header:
theorem tail_norm_tendsto_zero
    (h : SesquilinearCuspTailControl C) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ‖h.truncation n - C‖) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
  squeeze_zero
    (fun n => norm_nonneg (h.truncation n - C))
    h.tail_opNorm_le h.epsilon_tendsto_zero

/-- Forget the two-variable presentation and retain the compact
operator-norm approximation. -/
def compactApproximation
    (h : SesquilinearCuspTailControl C) :
    CuspTailCompactApproximation C where

declarations.name: isCompactOperator
declarations.header:
theorem isCompactOperator
    (h : SesquilinearCuspTailControl C) :
    IsCompactOperator C :=
  h.compactApproximation.isCompactOperator

end SesquilinearCuspTailControl

end SesquilinearCuspTail

/-! #### The compact-operator Fredholm alternative at μ = 1 -/

section FredholmCore

variable {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℂ X]

/-- The normalized Fredholm operator I - K. -/
def fredholmDefect (K : X →L[ℂ] X) : X →L[ℂ] X :=
  1 - K

@[simp]

declarations.name: fredholmDefect_apply
declarations.header:
theorem fredholmDefect_apply (K : X →L[ℂ] X) (u : X) :
    fredholmDefect K u = u - K u:=

declarations.name: fredholmDefect_hasTrivialKernel_of_fixedPointUnique
declarations.header:
theorem fredholmDefect_hasTrivialKernel_of_fixedPointUnique
    (K : X →L[ℂ] X)
    (hfixed : ∀ u, K u = u → u = 0) :
    HasTrivialKernel (fredholmDefect K):=

declarations.name: fredholmDefect_hasTrivialKernel_of_norm_lt_one
declarations.header:
theorem fredholmDefect_hasTrivialKernel_of_norm_lt_one
    (K : X →L[ℂ] X) (hK : ‖K‖ < 1) :
    HasTrivialKernel (fredholmDefect K):=

declarations.name: not_hasEigenvalue_one_of_hasTrivialKernel
declarations.header:
theorem not_hasEigenvalue_one_of_hasTrivialKernel
    (K : X →L[ℂ] X)
    (hker : HasTrivialKernel (fredholmDefect K)) :
    ¬ Module.End.HasEigenvalue (K : Module.End ℂ X) (1 : ℂ):=

declarations.name: one_mem_resolventSet
declarations.header:
theorem one_mem_resolventSet
    (K : X →L[ℂ] X) (hcompact : IsCompactOperator K)
    (hker : HasTrivialKernel (fredholmDefect K)) :
    (1 : ℂ) ∈ resolventSet ℂ K :=
  (hcompact.hasEigenvalue_or_mem_resolventSet
      (μ := (1 : ℂ)) one_ne_zero).resolve_left
    (not_hasEigenvalue_one_of_hasTrivialKernel K hker)

/-- Fredholm alternative plus the trivial kernel makes I-K bijective. -/

declarations.name: fredholmDefect_bijective
declarations.header:
theorem fredholmDefect_bijective
    (K : X →L[ℂ] X) (hcompact : IsCompactOperator K)
    (hker : HasTrivialKernel (fredholmDefect K)) :
    Function.Bijective (fredholmDefect K):=

declarations.name: fredholmEquiv_apply
declarations.header:
theorem fredholmEquiv_apply
    (K : X →L[ℂ] X) (hcompact : IsCompactOperator K)
    (hker : HasTrivialKernel (fredholmDefect K)) (u : X) :
    fredholmEquiv K hcompact hker u = u - K u:=

declarations.name: fredholmInverseNorm_nonneg
declarations.header:
theorem fredholmInverseNorm_nonneg
    (K : X →L[ℂ] X) (hcompact : IsCompactOperator K)
    (hker : HasTrivialKernel (fredholmDefect K)) :
    0 ≤ fredholmInverseNorm K hcompact hker :=
  norm_nonneg _

/-- Solution of the normalized equation (I-K)u=f. -/
noncomputable def fredholmSolve
    (K : X →L[ℂ] X) (hcompact : IsCompactOperator K)
    (hker : HasTrivialKernel (fredholmDefect K)) (f : X) : X :=
  (fredholmEquiv K hcompact hker).symm f

declarations.name: fredholmSolve_spec
declarations.header:
theorem fredholmSolve_spec
    (K : X →L[ℂ] X) (hcompact : IsCompactOperator K)
    (hker : HasTrivialKernel (fredholmDefect K)) (f : X) :
    fredholmDefect K (fredholmSolve K hcompact hker f) = f:=

declarations.name: fredholmSolve_unique
declarations.header:
theorem fredholmSolve_unique
    (K : X →L[ℂ] X) (hcompact : IsCompactOperator K)
    (hker : HasTrivialKernel (fredholmDefect K)) (f : X)
    {u : X} (hu : fredholmDefect K u = f) :
    u = fredholmSolve K hcompact hker f:=

declarations.name: fredholmSolve_norm_le
declarations.header:
theorem fredholmSolve_norm_le
    (K : X →L[ℂ] X) (hcompact : IsCompactOperator K)
    (hker : HasTrivialKernel (fredholmDefect K)) (f : X) :
    ‖fredholmSolve K hcompact hker f‖ ≤
      fredholmInverseNorm K hcompact hker * ‖f‖ :=
  (fredholmEquiv K hcompact hker).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm f

end FredholmCore

/-! #### Preconditioned compact perturbations -/

/-- Data for the exact factorization of an unshifted operator through a
shifted continuous equivalence and a compact lower-order term. -/
structure ShiftedCompactDecomposition
    {V W : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℂ V]
    [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℂ W]
    (A : V →L[ℂ] W) where

declarations.name: compactPerturbation_isCompact
declarations.header:
theorem compactPerturbation_isCompact
    (d : ShiftedCompactDecomposition A) :
    IsCompactOperator d.compactPerturbation:=

declarations.name: shifted_apply
declarations.header:
theorem shifted_apply
    (d : ShiftedCompactDecomposition A) (u : V) :
    d.shiftedEquiv u = A u + d.lowerOrder u:=

declarations.name: shifted_compactPerturbation_apply
declarations.header:
theorem shifted_compactPerturbation_apply
    (d : ShiftedCompactDecomposition A) (u : V) :
    d.shiftedEquiv (d.compactPerturbation u) =
      d.lowerOrder u:=

declarations.name: factorization_apply
declarations.header:
theorem factorization_apply
    (d : ShiftedCompactDecomposition A) (u : V) :
    d.shiftedEquiv
        (fredholmDefect d.compactPerturbation u) =
      A u:=

declarations.name: factorization
declarations.header:
theorem factorization
    (d : ShiftedCompactDecomposition A) :
    d.shiftedEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
        (fredholmDefect d.compactPerturbation) = A:=

declarations.name: defect_eq_zero_iff
declarations.header:
theorem defect_eq_zero_iff
    (d : ShiftedCompactDecomposition A) (u : V) :
    fredholmDefect d.compactPerturbation u = 0 ↔
      A u = 0:=

declarations.name: compactPerturbation_fixedPoint_iff
declarations.header:
theorem compactPerturbation_fixedPoint_iff
    (d : ShiftedCompactDecomposition A) (u : V) :
    d.compactPerturbation u = u ↔ A u = 0:=

declarations.name: normalized_hasTrivialKernel
declarations.header:
theorem normalized_hasTrivialKernel
    (d : ShiftedCompactDecomposition A)
    (hA : HasTrivialKernel A) :
    HasTrivialKernel (fredholmDefect d.compactPerturbation):=

declarations.name: compactPerturbation_isCompact
declarations.header:
theorem compactPerturbation_isCompact
    (d : FredholmBypassData A) :
    IsCompactOperator d.compactPerturbation :=
  d.toShiftedCompactDecomposition.compactPerturbation_isCompact

declarations.name: normalized_hasTrivialKernel
declarations.header:
theorem normalized_hasTrivialKernel
    (d : FredholmBypassData A) :
    HasTrivialKernel (fredholmDefect d.compactPerturbation) :=
  d.toShiftedCompactDecomposition.normalized_hasTrivialKernel
    d.unshiftedKernel

/-- The normalized I-K equivalence obtained from mathlib's Fredholm
alternative. -/
noncomputable def normalizedEquiv
    (d : FredholmBypassData A) : V ≃L[ℂ] V :=
  fredholmEquiv d.compactPerturbation
    d.compactPerturbation_isCompact
    d.normalized_hasTrivialKernel

/-- The actual unshifted equivalence A : V ≃L W. -/
noncomputable def unshiftedEquiv
    (d : FredholmBypassData A) : V ≃L[ℂ] W :=
  d.normalizedEquiv.trans d.shiftedEquiv

@[simp]

declarations.name: unshiftedEquiv_apply
declarations.header:
theorem unshiftedEquiv_apply
    (d : FredholmBypassData A) (u : V) :
    d.unshiftedEquiv u = A u:=

declarations.name: normalizedInverseNorm_nonneg
declarations.header:
theorem normalizedInverseNorm_nonneg
    (d : FredholmBypassData A) :
    0 ≤ d.normalizedInverseNorm :=
  norm_nonneg _

/-- The actual inverse continuous linear map of the unshifted operator. -/
noncomputable def solutionOperator
    (d : FredholmBypassData A) : W →L[ℂ] V :=
  d.unshiftedEquiv.symm.toContinuousLinearMap

/-- Norm of the actual unshifted inverse.  This is deliberately a second
constant, distinct from both shifted coercivity and the normalized inverse
norm. -/
noncomputable def inverseNorm
    (d : FredholmBypassData A) : ℝ :=
  ‖d.solutionOperator‖

declarations.name: inverseNorm_nonneg
declarations.header:
theorem inverseNorm_nonneg
    (d : FredholmBypassData A) :
    0 ≤ d.inverseNorm :=
  norm_nonneg _

/-- The unshifted Fredholm solution. -/
noncomputable def solve
    (d : FredholmBypassData A) (F : W) : V :=
  d.solutionOperator F

declarations.name: solve_spec
declarations.header:
theorem solve_spec
    (d : FredholmBypassData A) (F : W) :
    A (d.solve F) = F:=

declarations.name: solve_unique
declarations.header:
theorem solve_unique
    (d : FredholmBypassData A) (F : W)
    {u : V} (hu : A u = F) :
    u = d.solve F:=

declarations.name: solve_existsUnique
declarations.header:
theorem solve_existsUnique
    (d : FredholmBypassData A) (F : W) :
    ∃! u : V, A u = F:=

declarations.name: solutionOperator_rightInverse
declarations.header:
theorem solutionOperator_rightInverse
    (d : FredholmBypassData A) (F : W) :
    A (d.solutionOperator F) = F :=
  d.solve_spec F

declarations.name: solutionOperator_leftInverse
declarations.header:
theorem solutionOperator_leftInverse
    (d : FredholmBypassData A) (u : V) :
    d.solutionOperator (A u) = u:=

declarations.name: solve_norm_le
declarations.header:
theorem solve_norm_le
    (d : FredholmBypassData A) (F : W) :
    ‖d.solve F‖ ≤ d.inverseNorm * ‖F‖ :=
  d.solutionOperator.le_opNorm F

/-- Two-stage bound exposing the separate normalized Fredholm constant. -/

declarations.name: solve_norm_le_normalized
declarations.header:
theorem solve_norm_le_normalized
    (d : FredholmBypassData A) (F : W) :
    ‖d.solve F‖ ≤
      d.normalizedInverseNorm * ‖d.shiftedEquiv.symm F‖:=

declarations.name: coerciveForm_injective
declarations.header:
theorem coerciveForm_injective
    (α : ℝ) (S : ContinuousSesquilinearForm V)
    (hS : ComplexCoerciveWith α S) :
    Function.Injective S:=

declarations.name: coerciveForm_surjective
declarations.header:
theorem coerciveForm_surjective
    (α : ℝ) (S : ContinuousSesquilinearForm V)
    (hS : ComplexCoerciveWith α S) :
    Function.Surjective S:=

declarations.name: coerciveFormEquiv_apply
declarations.header:
theorem coerciveFormEquiv_apply
    (α : ℝ) (S : ContinuousSesquilinearForm V)
    (hS : ComplexCoerciveWith α S) (u : V) :
    coerciveFormEquiv α S hS u = S u :=
  rfl

/-- The inverse of the bundled form equivalence is the same solution
characterized by the 5.3 solver. -/

declarations.name: coerciveFormEquiv_symm_apply
declarations.header:
theorem coerciveFormEquiv_symm_apply
    (α : ℝ) (S : ContinuousSesquilinearForm V)
    (hS : ComplexCoerciveWith α S)
    (F : StrongAntiDual V) :
    (coerciveFormEquiv α S hS).symm F =
      solveWith α S hS F:=

declarations.name: coerciveFormEquiv_symm_norm_le
declarations.header:
theorem coerciveFormEquiv_symm_norm_le
    (α : ℝ) (S : ContinuousSesquilinearForm V)
    (hS : ComplexCoerciveWith α S)
    (F : StrongAntiDual V) :
    ‖(coerciveFormEquiv α S hS).symm F‖ ≤
      α⁻¹ * ‖F‖:=

declarations.name: shiftedFredholmData_shiftedEquiv_symm_apply
declarations.header:
theorem shiftedFredholmData_shiftedEquiv_symm_apply
    (α : ℝ)
    (A mass : ContinuousSesquilinearForm V) (lam : ℝ)
    (hShift : ComplexCoerciveWith α (shiftedForm A mass lam))
    (hmass : IsCompactOperator mass)
    (hker : HasTrivialKernel A)
    (F : StrongAntiDual V) :
    (shiftedFredholmData α A mass lam hShift hmass hker).shiftedEquiv.symm F =
      solveWith α (shiftedForm A mass lam) hShift F:=

declarations.name: solveOfShiftedForm_spec
declarations.header:
theorem solveOfShiftedForm_spec
    (α : ℝ)
    (A mass : ContinuousSesquilinearForm V) (lam : ℝ)
    (hShift : ComplexCoerciveWith α (shiftedForm A mass lam))
    (hmass : IsCompactOperator mass)
    (hker : HasTrivialKernel A)
    (F : StrongAntiDual V) :
    A (solveOfShiftedForm α A mass lam hShift hmass hker F) = F :=
  (shiftedFredholmData α A mass lam hShift hmass hker).solve_spec F

declarations.name: solveOfShiftedForm_existsUnique
declarations.header:
theorem solveOfShiftedForm_existsUnique
    (α : ℝ)
    (A mass : ContinuousSesquilinearForm V) (lam : ℝ)
    (hShift : ComplexCoerciveWith α (shiftedForm A mass lam))
    (hmass : IsCompactOperator mass)
    (hker : HasTrivialKernel A)
    (F : StrongAntiDual V) :
    ∃! u : V, A u = F :=
  (shiftedFredholmData α A mass lam hShift hmass hker).solve_existsUnique F

/-- Two-stage estimate.  The new normalized inverse norm is not replaced by
the shifted coercivity constant. -/

declarations.name: solveOfShiftedForm_norm_le
declarations.header:
theorem solveOfShiftedForm_norm_le
    (α : ℝ)
    (A mass : ContinuousSesquilinearForm V) (lam : ℝ)
    (hShift : ComplexCoerciveWith α (shiftedForm A mass lam))
    (hmass : IsCompactOperator mass)
    (hker : HasTrivialKernel A)
    (F : StrongAntiDual V) :
    ‖solveOfShiftedForm α A mass lam hShift hmass hker F‖ ≤
      (shiftedFredholmData α A mass lam hShift hmass hker).normalizedInverseNorm *
        (α⁻¹ * ‖F‖):=

declarations.name: shiftedFredholm_inverseNorm_le
declarations.header:
theorem shiftedFredholm_inverseNorm_le
    (α : ℝ)
    (A mass : ContinuousSesquilinearForm V) (lam : ℝ)
    (hShift : ComplexCoerciveWith α (shiftedForm A mass lam))
    (hmass : IsCompactOperator mass)
    (hker : HasTrivialKernel A) :
    (shiftedFredholmData α A mass lam hShift hmass hker).inverseNorm ≤
      (shiftedFredholmData α A mass lam hShift hmass hker).normalizedInverseNorm *
        α⁻¹:=

declarations.name: fredholmDefectKernelComplementRestriction_apply
declarations.header:
theorem fredholmDefectKernelComplementRestriction_apply
    (K : X →L[ℂ] X) (u : (fredholmDefect K).kerᗮ) :
    fredholmDefectKernelComplementRestriction K u =
      fredholmDefect K (u : X) :=
  rfl

/-- The kernel-complement restriction is injective even when `I - K` has a
nontrivial kernel. -/

declarations.name: fredholmDefectKernelComplementRestriction_injective
declarations.header:
theorem fredholmDefectKernelComplementRestriction_injective
    (K : X →L[ℂ] X) :
    Function.Injective (fredholmDefectKernelComplementRestriction K):=

declarations.name: fredholmDefectKernelComplementRestriction_antilipschitz
declarations.header:
theorem fredholmDefectKernelComplementRestriction_antilipschitz
    (K : X →L[ℂ] X) (hK : IsCompactOperator K) :
    ∃ C, AntilipschitzWith C
      (fredholmDefectKernelComplementRestriction K):=

declarations.name: fredholmDefectKernelComplementRestriction_range
declarations.header:
theorem fredholmDefectKernelComplementRestriction_range
    (K : X →L[ℂ] X) :
    (fredholmDefectKernelComplementRestriction K).range =
      (fredholmDefect K).range:=

declarations.name: fredholmDefect_range_isClosed
declarations.header:
theorem fredholmDefect_range_isClosed
    (K : X →L[ℂ] X) (hK : IsCompactOperator K) :
    IsClosed ((fredholmDefect K).range : Set X):=

declarations.name: ShiftedCompactDecomposition.range_isClosed
declarations.header:
theorem ShiftedCompactDecomposition.range_isClosed
    (d : ShiftedCompactDecomposition A) :
    IsClosed (A.range : Set W):=

declarations.name: range_isClosed
declarations.header:
theorem range_isClosed (d : NontrivialKernelFredholmData A) :
    IsClosed (A.range : Set W) :=
  d.toShiftedCompactDecomposition.range_isClosed

/-- The restriction of `A` from the orthogonal complement of its kernel to its
actual range. -/
noncomputable def kernelComplementRestriction (d : NontrivialKernelFredholmData A) :
    A.kerᗮ →L[ℂ] A.range :=
  (A.comp A.kerᗮ.subtypeL).codRestrict A.range
    (fun u => ⟨(u : V), rfl⟩)

@[simp]

declarations.name: kernelComplementRestriction_apply
declarations.header:
theorem kernelComplementRestriction_apply
    (d : NontrivialKernelFredholmData A) (u : A.kerᗮ) :
    ((d.kernelComplementRestriction u : A.range) : W) = A (u : V) :=
  rfl

/-- The kernel-complement restriction is injective without assuming that the
original kernel is trivial. -/

declarations.name: kernelComplementRestriction_injective
declarations.header:
theorem kernelComplementRestriction_injective
    (d : NontrivialKernelFredholmData A) :
    Function.Injective d.kernelComplementRestriction:=

declarations.name: kernelComplementRestriction_surjective
declarations.header:
theorem kernelComplementRestriction_surjective
    (d : NontrivialKernelFredholmData A) :
    Function.Surjective d.kernelComplementRestriction:=

declarations.name: kernelComplementEquivRange_apply
declarations.header:
theorem kernelComplementEquivRange_apply
    (d : NontrivialKernelFredholmData A) (u : A.kerᗮ) :
    ((d.kernelComplementEquivRange u : A.range) : W) = A (u : V) :=
  rfl

/-- The canonical solution operator takes compatible forcing terms (elements
of the actual range) to the unique solution orthogonal to `ker A`. -/
noncomputable def canonicalSolutionOperator
    (d : NontrivialKernelFredholmData A) : A.range →L[ℂ] V :=
  A.kerᗮ.subtypeL.comp
    d.kernelComplementEquivRange.symm.toContinuousLinearMap

/-- Canonical kernel-orthogonal solution for a compatible forcing term. -/
noncomputable def canonicalSolution
    (d : NontrivialKernelFredholmData A) (f : A.range) : V :=
  d.canonicalSolutionOperator f

@[simp]

declarations.name: canonicalSolution_eq
declarations.header:
theorem canonicalSolution_eq
    (d : NontrivialKernelFredholmData A) (f : A.range) :
    d.canonicalSolution f =
      (d.kernelComplementEquivRange.symm f : A.kerᗮ) :=
  rfl

/-- The canonical solution satisfies the original unshifted equation. -/

declarations.name: canonicalSolution_spec
declarations.header:
theorem canonicalSolution_spec
    (d : NontrivialKernelFredholmData A) (f : A.range) :
    A (d.canonicalSolution f) = (f : W):=

declarations.name: canonicalSolution_mem_kernelOrthogonal
declarations.header:
theorem canonicalSolution_mem_kernelOrthogonal
    (d : NontrivialKernelFredholmData A) (f : A.range) :
    d.canonicalSolution f ∈ A.kerᗮ :=
  (d.kernelComplementEquivRange.symm f).property

/-- Uniqueness holds exactly after imposing the kernel-orthogonality
normalization. -/

declarations.name: canonicalSolution_unique
declarations.header:
theorem canonicalSolution_unique
    (d : NontrivialKernelFredholmData A) (f : A.range)
    {u : V} (hu : A u = (f : W)) (huOrth : u ∈ A.kerᗮ) :
    u = d.canonicalSolution f:=

declarations.name: solves_iff_canonical_add_kernel

/-! #### Raw unweighted norm defect

The holomorphic covariance convention does not make the raw pointwise norm
invariant.  The next lemmas record its exact scaling law before the invariant
fiber metric is introduced below. -/

/-- Raw pointwise norm, with no compensating line-bundle metric. -/
noncomputable def rawPointwiseNorm (u : WeightSection M) (z : ℍ) : ℝ :=
  ‖u z‖

/-- Raw unweighted norm-square density. -/
noncomputable def rawPointwiseNormSq (u : WeightSection M) (z : ℍ) : ℝ :=
  ‖u z‖ ^ 2

/-- Exact transformation law for the raw pointwise norm. -/

declarations.name: rawPointwiseNorm_smul
declarations.header:
theorem rawPointwiseNorm_smul (u : WeightSection M)
    (γ : Γ) (z : ℍ) :
    rawPointwiseNorm u ((γ : SL(2, ℤ)) • z) =
      ‖M.factor γ z‖ * rawPointwiseNorm u z:=

declarations.name: rawPointwiseNormSq_smul
declarations.header:
theorem rawPointwiseNormSq_smul (u : WeightSection M)
    (γ : Γ) (z : ℍ) :
    rawPointwiseNormSq u ((γ : SL(2, ℤ)) • z) =
      ‖M.factor γ z‖ ^ 2 * rawPointwiseNormSq u z:=

declarations.name: rawPointwiseNormSq_smul_sub
declarations.header:
theorem rawPointwiseNormSq_smul_sub (u : WeightSection M)
    (γ : Γ) (z : ℍ) :
    rawPointwiseNormSq u ((γ : SL(2, ℤ)) • z) -
        rawPointwiseNormSq u z =
      (‖M.factor γ z‖ ^ 2 - 1) * rawPointwiseNormSq u z:=

declarations.name: rawPointwiseNormSq_smul_halfWeight
declarations.header:
theorem rawPointwiseNormSq_smul_halfWeight
    (M : HalfIntegralMultiplier Γ 1) (u : WeightSection M)
    (γ : Γ) (z : ℍ) :
    rawPointwiseNormSq u ((γ : SL(2, ℤ)) • z) =
      ‖UpperHalfPlane.denom (γ : SL(2, ℤ)) z‖⁻¹ *
        rawPointwiseNormSq u z:=

declarations.name: rawPointwiseNormSq_noninvariant_but_metric_invariant
declarations.header:
theorem rawPointwiseNormSq_noninvariant_but_metric_invariant
    (m : InvariantFiberMetric M) (u : WeightSection M)
    (γ : Γ) (z : ℍ)
    (hfactor : ‖M.factor γ z‖ ≠ 1) (hu : u z ≠ 0) :

        m.pointwiseNormSq u z :=

declarations.header:

    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (D : GammaTwoFundamentalDomain) (f : GammaTwoQuotient → E)
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f D.quotientMeasure) :
    ∫ q, f q ∂D.quotientMeasure =
      ∫ z in D.carrier, f (gammaTwoQuotientMk z) ∂hyperbolicMeasure:=

    (D₁ D₂ : GammaTwoFundamentalDomain) (f : ℍ → E)
    (hf : ∀ g : GammaTwoEffective, ∀ z, f (g • z) = f z) :
    IntegrableOn f D₁.carrier hyperbolicMeasure ↔
      IntegrableOn f D₂.carrier hyperbolicMeasure :=
  D₁.isFundamental.integrableOn_iff D₂.isFundamental hf

/-- The fundamental-domain integral of an invariant Bochner integrand is
independent of every certified choice, including in the non-integrable case
where both Bochner integrals are definitionally zero. -/

declarations.name: setIntegral_eq
declarations.header:
theorem setIntegral_eq
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (D₁ D₂ : GammaTwoFundamentalDomain) (f : ℍ → E)
    (hf : ∀ g : GammaTwoEffective, ∀ z, f (g • z) = f z) :
    ∫ z in D₁.carrier, f z ∂hyperbolicMeasure =
      ∫ z in D₂.carrier, f z ∂hyperbolicMeasure :=
  D₁.isFundamental.setIntegral_eq D₂.isFundamental hf

/-- Descend an invariant function to the effective orbit quotient. -/
noncomputable def descendInvariant {E : Type*} (ρ : ℍ → E)
    (hρ : ∀ g : GammaTwoEffective, ∀ z, ρ (g • z) = ρ z) :
    GammaTwoQuotient → E :=
  Quotient.lift ρ (by
    intro a b hab
    rcases hab with ⟨g, rfl⟩
    exact hρ g b)

    (z : ℍ) :
    descendInvariant ρ hρ (gammaTwoQuotientMk z) = ρ z :=
  rfl

declarations.name: GammaTwoFundamentalDomain.integral_descendInvariant_eq
declarations.header:

/-- The closed standard polygon
`-1 ≤ x ≤ 1`, exterior to both radius-`1/2` semicircles. -/
def gammaTwoStandardPolygonClosed : Set ℍ :=
  {z : ℍ | -1 ≤ z.re} ∩
  {z : ℍ | z.re ≤ 1} ∩
  {z : ℍ | (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ gammaTwoLeftCircleDistance z} ∩
  {z : ℍ | (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ gammaTwoRightCircleDistance z}

/-- The open interior of the standard ideal quadrilateral. -/
def gammaTwoStandardPolygonOpen : Set ℍ :=
  {z : ℍ | -1 < z.re} ∩
  {z : ℍ | z.re < 1} ∩
  {z : ℍ | (1 : ℝ) / 2 < gammaTwoLeftCircleDistance z} ∩
  {z : ℍ | (1 : ℝ) / 2 < gammaTwoRightCircleDistance z}

/-- A concrete half-open convention: retain the left vertical and left
circular sides, and discard their right partners.  The ideal vertices are on
the real boundary and hence are not points of `ℍ`. -/
def gammaTwoStandardPolygonHalfOpen : Set ℍ :=
  {z : ℍ | -1 ≤ z.re} ∩
  {z : ℍ | z.re < 1} ∩
  {z : ℍ | (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ gammaTwoLeftCircleDistance z} ∩
  {z : ℍ | (1 : ℝ) / 2 < gammaTwoRightCircleDistance z}

/-- Cusp class of the ideal point `gammaTwoCosetRep q • ∞`.  For the primitive

    .atInfinity

    .zero
  else
    .one

/-- Removing finitely many parameter values from an arbitrary parameter set
does not change any Bochner set integral.  No integrability hypothesis is
needed because `setIntegral_congr_set` also identifies the nonintegrable-zero
branches of the Bochner integral definition. -/

declarations.name: setIntegral_diff_finset_eq
declarations.header:
theorem setIntegral_diff_finset_eq
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (f : ℝ → E) (I : Set ℝ) (vertices : Finset ℝ) :
    (∫ t in I \ (vertices : Set ℝ), f t) =
      ∫ t in I, f t:=

declarations.name: GammaTwoBoundaryParametrization.integral_remove_endpoints
declarations.header:
theorem GammaTwoBoundaryParametrization.integral_remove_endpoints
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (P : GammaTwoBoundaryParametrization) (f : ℝ → E) :
    (∫ t in P.parameterSet \ (P.endpoints : Set ℝ), f t) =
      ∫ t in P.parameterSet, f t :=
  setIntegral_diff_finset_eq f P.parameterSet P.endpoints

/-- Endpoint deletion after composing a boundary density with the actual
geometric parametrization. -/

declarations.name: GammaTwoBoundaryParametrization.integral_comp_remove_endpoints
declarations.header:
theorem GammaTwoBoundaryParametrization.integral_comp_remove_endpoints
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (P : GammaTwoBoundaryParametrization) (F : ℍ → E) :
    (∫ t in P.parameterSet \ (P.endpoints : Set ℝ), F (P.point t)) =
      ∫ t in P.parameterSet, F (P.point t) :=
  setIntegral_diff_finset_eq (F ∘ P.point) P.parameterSet P.endpoints

theorem gammaTwoActualPolygonEdge_integral_remove_vertices
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (e : GammaTwoActualPolygonEdge) (F : ℍ → E) :
    (∫ t in
        (gammaTwoActualPolygonEdgeBoundaryParametrization e).parameterSet \
          ((gammaTwoActualPolygonEdgeBoundaryParametrization e).endpoints : Set ℝ),
        F ((gammaTwoActualPolygonEdgeBoundaryParametrization e).point t)) =
      ∫ t in
        (gammaTwoActualPolygonEdgeBoundaryParametrization e).parameterSet,
        F ((gammaTwoActualPolygonEdgeBoundaryParametrization e).point t) :=
  (gammaTwoActualPolygonEdgeBoundaryParametrization e).integral_comp_remove_endpoints F

/-- Finite summation preserves endpoint deletion.  Thus a vertex shared by
several boundary records can be deleted in every record without changing the
total one-dimensional flux. -/

declarations.name: GammaTwoBoundaryParametrization.finset_sum_integral_remove_endpoints
declarations.header:
theorem GammaTwoBoundaryParametrization.finset_sum_integral_remove_endpoints
    {ι E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (s : Finset ι) (P : ι → GammaTwoBoundaryParametrization)
    (F : ι → ℍ → E) :
    (∑ i ∈ s,
        ∫ t in (P i).parameterSet \ ((P i).endpoints : Set ℝ),
          F i ((P i).point t)) =
      ∑ i ∈ s,
        ∫ t in (P i).parameterSet, F i ((P i).point t):=

theorem gammaTwoActualPolygonEdges_sum_integral_remove_vertices

    (∑ e : GammaTwoActualPolygonEdge,

              ((gammaTwoActualPolygonEdgeBoundaryParametrization e).endpoints : Set ℝ),

      ∑ e : GammaTwoActualPolygonEdge,

          F e ((gammaTwoActualPolygonEdgeBoundaryParametrization e).point t):=

/-! #### Concrete compact lifts of quotient compacta

The open measured fundamental-domain carrier is intentionally allowed to miss
boundary orbits.  It therefore cannot serve as a pointwise representative set
for every compact subset of the quotient.  The open quotient map nevertheless
gives a different, completely unconditional construction: a compact quotient
set has a compact lift upstairs.  Indeed, compact neighbourhoods of chosen
representatives have open images, and finitely many of those images cover the
given compact set.
-/

image of a compact subset of the upper half-plane. -/

declarations.header:

/-- Topological support on the quotient.  The closure is important: it is the
downstairs analogue of `tsupport`, and it makes compact support stable under
addition and scalar multiplication. -/
def quotientTSupport (u : ℍ → ℂ) : Set GammaTwoQuotient :=
  closure (gammaTwoQuotientMk '' Function.support u)

/-- A lifted automorphic function is compactly supported modulo `Gamma(2)`. -/
def HasQuotientCompactSupport (u : ℍ → ℂ) : Prop :=
  IsCompact (quotientTSupport u)

          star (u z) * v z:=

/-- The universal extra term in the raising-chain-rule calculation when the
operator coefficient `r` differs from the covariance exponent `q`. -/
def raisingCovarianceDefect
    (q r c nu jPow u : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  2 * Complex.I * c * (q - r) * nu * jPow * u

    (γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) {f : ℍ → ℂ}

    wirtingerZ (fun w ↦ f
        (((γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) : SL(2, ℤ)) • w)) z =
      (inverseEtaPaperOrbitDenom γ z ^ 2)⁻¹ *
        wirtingerZ f
          ((((γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) : SL(2, ℤ)) • z)):=

declarations.name: wirtingerBar_comp_gammaTwo_smul
declarations.header:
theorem wirtingerBar_comp_gammaTwo_smul
    (γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) {f : ℍ → ℂ}
    (hf : RealSmooth f) (z : ℍ) :
    wirtingerBar (fun w ↦ f
        (((γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) : SL(2, ℤ)) • w)) z =
      star ((inverseEtaPaperOrbitDenom γ z ^ 2)⁻¹) *
        wirtingerBar f
          ((((γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) : SL(2, ℤ)) • z)):=

declarations.name: heightC_gammaTwo_smul
declarations.header:
theorem heightC_gammaTwo_smul
    (γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) (z : ℍ) :
    heightC ((((γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) :
        SL(2, ℤ)) • z)) =
      heightC z /
        (Complex.normSq (inverseEtaPaperOrbitDenom γ z) : ℂ):=

declarations.name: gammaTwoMoebius_derivative_height_compatibility
declarations.header:
theorem gammaTwoMoebius_derivative_height_compatibility
    (γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) (z : ℍ) :
    deriv (gammaTwoMoebiusChart γ) (z : ℂ) =
        1 / inverseEtaPaperOrbitDenom γ z ^ 2 ∧
      heightC ((((γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) :
          SL(2, ℤ)) • z)) =
        heightC z /
          (Complex.normSq (inverseEtaPaperOrbitDenom γ z) : ℂ) :=
  ⟨deriv_gammaTwoMoebiusChart γ z, heightC_gammaTwo_smul γ z⟩

/-- Elementary denominator identity responsible for the zero-order
correction in the raising operator. -/

declarations.name: inverseEtaPaperOrbitDenom_sq_eq_normSq_add
declarations.header:
theorem inverseEtaPaperOrbitDenom_sq_eq_normSq_add
    (γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) (z : ℍ) :
    inverseEtaPaperOrbitDenom γ z ^ 2 =
      (Complex.normSq (inverseEtaPaperOrbitDenom γ z) : ℂ) +
        2 * Complex.I * inverseEtaPaperOrbitLowerLeft γ *
          heightC z * inverseEtaPaperOrbitDenom γ z:=

declarations.name: inverseEtaPaperOrbit_normSq_ne_zero
declarations.header:
theorem inverseEtaPaperOrbit_normSq_ne_zero
    (γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) (z : ℍ) :
    (Complex.normSq (inverseEtaPaperOrbitDenom γ z) : ℂ) ≠ 0:=

declarations.name: inverseEtaPaperOrbitFactor_add_one
declarations.header:
theorem inverseEtaPaperOrbitFactor_add_one (n : ℤ)
    (γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) (z : ℍ) :
    inverseEtaPaperOrbitFactor (n + 1) γ z =
      inverseEtaPaperOrbitFactor n γ z *
        inverseEtaPaperOrbitDenom γ z ^ 2:=

declarations.name: inverseEtaPaperOrbitFactor_sub_one
declarations.header:
theorem inverseEtaPaperOrbitFactor_sub_one (n : ℤ)
    (γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) (z : ℍ) :
    inverseEtaPaperOrbitFactor (n - 1) γ z =
      inverseEtaPaperOrbitFactor n γ z /
        inverseEtaPaperOrbitDenom γ z ^ 2:=

declarations.name: IsInverseEtaPaperOrbitCovariant.comp_smul_eq_factor_mul
declarations.header:
theorem IsInverseEtaPaperOrbitCovariant.comp_smul_eq_factor_mul

    (hf : IsInverseEtaPaperOrbitCovariant n f)
    (γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) :
    (fun z : ℍ ↦ (f : ℍ → ℂ)
      (((γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) : SL(2, ℤ)) • z)) =
      inverseEtaPaperOrbitFactor n γ * (f : ℍ → ℂ):=

declarations.name: raiseRaw_covariance_of_inverseEtaPaperOrbitCovariant
declarations.header:
theorem raiseRaw_covariance_of_inverseEtaPaperOrbitCovariant
    {n : ℤ} {f : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction}
    (hf : IsInverseEtaPaperOrbitCovariant n f)
    (γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) (z : ℍ) :
    raiseRaw (paperOrbitExponent n) (f : ℍ → ℂ)
        ((((γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) : SL(2, ℤ)) • z)) =
      inverseEtaPaperOrbitFactor (n + 1) γ z *
        raiseRaw (paperOrbitExponent n) (f : ℍ → ℂ) z:=

declarations.name: lowerRaw_covariance_of_inverseEtaPaperOrbitCovariant
declarations.header:
theorem lowerRaw_covariance_of_inverseEtaPaperOrbitCovariant
    {n : ℤ} {f : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction}
    (hf : IsInverseEtaPaperOrbitCovariant n f)
    (γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) (z : ℍ) :
    lowerRaw (paperOrbitExponent n) (f : ℍ → ℂ)
        ((((γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) : SL(2, ℤ)) • z)) =
      inverseEtaPaperOrbitFactor (n - 1) γ z *
        lowerRaw (paperOrbitExponent n) (f : ℍ → ℂ) z:=

declarations.name: raiseRaw
declarations.header:
theorem raiseRaw {n : ℤ} {f : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction}

declarations.name: invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw_apply
declarations.header:
theorem invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw_apply

      hSectionSmooth : ℍ → ℂ) z =

declarations.name: invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw_covariant
declarations.header:
theorem invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw_covariant

    (orbitSection : InverseEtaPaperOrbitSection
      GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo n)
    (hSectionSmooth : RealSmooth (orbitSection : ℍ → ℂ)) :

        hSectionSmooth):=

declarations.name: invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw_mem
declarations.header:
theorem invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw_mem
    (n : ℤ) (cutoff : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction)
    (hCutoffInvariant : IsGammaTwoInvariantCutoff cutoff)
    (orbitSection : InverseEtaPaperOrbitSection
      GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo n)
    (hSectionSmooth : RealSmooth (orbitSection : ℍ → ℂ)) :
    invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw n cutoff orbitSection
        hSectionSmooth ∈
      inverseEtaFixedPhaseStableCoreSubmodule n :=
  (mem_inverseEtaFixedPhaseStableCoreSubmodule_iff n
    (invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw n cutoff orbitSection
      hSectionSmooth)).2
    (invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw_covariant n cutoff
      hCutoffInvariant orbitSection hSectionSmooth)

/-- Typed natural test-core element obtained from an invariant cutoff and a
genuine smooth section at orbit index `n`. -/
noncomputable def invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSection
    (n : ℤ) (cutoff : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction)
    (hCutoffInvariant : IsGammaTwoInvariantCutoff cutoff)
    (orbitSection : InverseEtaPaperOrbitSection
      GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo n)
    (hSectionSmooth : RealSmooth (orbitSection : ℍ → ℂ)) :
    InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n :=
  ⟨invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw n cutoff orbitSection
      hSectionSmooth,
    invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSectionRaw_mem n cutoff hCutoffInvariant
      orbitSection hSectionSmooth⟩

@[simp]

declarations.name: invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSection_apply
declarations.header:
theorem invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSection_apply
    (n : ℤ) (cutoff : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction)
    (hCutoffInvariant : IsGammaTwoInvariantCutoff cutoff)
    (orbitSection : InverseEtaPaperOrbitSection
      GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo n)
    (hSectionSmooth : RealSmooth (orbitSection : ℍ → ℂ)) (z : ℍ) :
    (invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSection n cutoff hCutoffInvariant orbitSection
        hSectionSmooth).1 z =
        (cutoff : ℍ → ℂ) z * orbitSection z :=
  rfl

/-- Exact nonvanishing criterion for the natural product.  In particular, no
unsupported claim that every orbit index already has a nonzero seed section
is made: a common point where both supplied factors are nonzero is sufficient. -/

declarations.name: invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSection_ne_zero
declarations.header:
theorem invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSection_ne_zero
    (n : ℤ) (cutoff : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction)
    (hCutoffInvariant : IsGammaTwoInvariantCutoff cutoff)
    (orbitSection : InverseEtaPaperOrbitSection
      GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo n)
    (hSectionSmooth : RealSmooth (orbitSection : ℍ → ℂ)) (z : ℍ)
    (hCutoff : (cutoff : ℍ → ℂ) z ≠ 0)
    (hSection : orbitSection z ≠ 0) :
    invariantCutoffTimesOrbitSection n cutoff hCutoffInvariant orbitSection
        hSectionSmooth ≠ (0 : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n):=

declarations.header:
theorem toWeightSection_apply (n : ℤ)

declarations.header:
theorem toSmoothCompactWeightCore_apply (n : ℤ)

    SmoothCompactWeightCore.toSection
        (toSmoothCompactWeightCore n u) z =
      (u : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) z :=

/-- No information is lost when the stable core is viewed as a shifted
Petersson smooth compact core. -/

declarations.name: toSmoothCompactWeightCore_injective
declarations.header:
theorem toSmoothCompactWeightCore_injective (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (toSmoothCompactWeightCore n):=

declarations.name: raise_apply
declarations.header:
theorem raise_apply (n : ℤ) (u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) (z : ℍ) :

        SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) z =

        (u : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) z :=

        (u : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) z :=

declarations.header:
theorem lowerFromSucc_apply (n : ℤ)

declarations.name: raiseFromPred_apply
declarations.header:
theorem raiseFromPred_apply (n : ℤ)

        (u : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) z :=

/-- Raising preserves real `C∞` regularity on the actual typed core. -/

declarations.name: raise_realSmooth
declarations.header:
theorem raise_realSmooth (n : ℤ) (u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) :
    RealSmooth
      (((raise n u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore (n + 1)) :
        SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) : ℍ → ℂ) :=
  (raise n u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore (n + 1)).1.1.2

/-- Lowering preserves real `C∞` regularity on the actual typed core. -/

declarations.name: lower_realSmooth
declarations.header:
theorem lower_realSmooth (n : ℤ) (u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) :
    RealSmooth
      (((lower n u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore (n - 1)) :
        SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) : ℍ → ℂ) :=
  (lower n u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore (n - 1)).1.1.2

/-- Raising preserves compact support on the effective quotient. -/

declarations.name: raise_quotientCompact
declarations.header:
theorem raise_quotientCompact (n : ℤ)
    (u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) :
    HasQuotientCompactSupport
      (((raise n u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore (n + 1)) :
        SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) : ℍ → ℂ) :=
  (raise n u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore (n + 1)).1.2

/-- Lowering preserves compact support on the effective quotient. -/

declarations.name: lower_quotientCompact
declarations.header:
theorem lower_quotientCompact (n : ℤ)
    (u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) :
    HasQuotientCompactSupport
      (((lower n u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore (n - 1)) :
        SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) : ℍ → ℂ) :=
  (lower n u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore (n - 1)).1.2

/-- Exact shifted-weight covariance of the actual raising operator. -/

declarations.name: raise_covariance
declarations.header:
theorem raise_covariance (n : ℤ) (u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n)
    (γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) (z : ℍ) :
    ((raise n u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore (n + 1)) :
        SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) ((γ : SL(2, ℤ)) • z) =
      (inverseEtaPaperOrbitMultiplier
          GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo (n + 1)).factor γ z *
        ((raise n u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore (n + 1)) :
          SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) z:=

declarations.name: lower_covariance
declarations.header:
theorem lower_covariance (n : ℤ) (u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n)
    (γ : GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo) (z : ℍ) :
    ((lower n u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore (n - 1)) :
        SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) ((γ : SL(2, ℤ)) • z) =
      (inverseEtaPaperOrbitMultiplier
          GammaTwoQuotientGeometry.GammaTwo (n - 1)).factor γ z *
        ((lower n u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore (n - 1)) :
          SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) z:=

declarations.name: raise_add
declarations.header:
theorem raise_add (n : ℤ) (u v : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) :
    raise n (u + v) = raise n u + raise n v :=
  map_add (raise n) u v

@[simp]

declarations.name: raise_smul
declarations.header:
theorem raise_smul (n : ℤ) (c : ℂ) (u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) :
    raise n (c • u) = c • raise n u :=
  map_smul (raise n) c u

/-- Complex linearity is part of the bundled lowering operator. -/
@[simp]

declarations.name: lower_add
declarations.header:
theorem lower_add (n : ℤ) (u v : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) :
    lower n (u + v) = lower n u + lower n v :=
  map_add (lower n) u v

@[simp]

declarations.name: lower_smul
declarations.header:
theorem lower_smul (n : ℤ) (c : ℂ) (u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) :
    lower n (c • u) = c • lower n u :=
  map_smul (lower n) c u

/-- Exact lower-after-raise factorization on the actual fixed-phase core,
including the weight-dependent constant term. -/

declarations.name: lower_raise_factorization
declarations.header:
theorem lower_raise_factorization (n : ℤ)
    (u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) (z : ℍ) :
    -laplaceRaw (paperOrbitExponent n)
        (u : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) z =
      (((lowerFromSucc n (raise n u) :
          InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) :
        SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) : ℍ → ℂ) z +
        physicalExponent (paperOrbitExponent n) *
          (u : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) z:=

declarations.name: raise_lower_factorization
declarations.header:
theorem raise_lower_factorization (n : ℤ)
    (u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) (z : ℍ) :
    -laplaceRaw (paperOrbitExponent n)
        (u : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) z =
      (((raiseFromPred n (lower n u) :
          InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) :
        SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) : ℍ → ℂ) z:=

declarations.name: averaged_factorization
declarations.header:
theorem averaged_factorization (n : ℤ)
    (u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) (z : ℍ) :
    -laplaceRaw (paperOrbitExponent n)
        (u : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) z =
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
        ((((lowerFromSucc n (raise n u) :
            InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) :
          SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) : ℍ → ℂ) z +
          (((raiseFromPred n (lower n u) :
              InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) :
            SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) : ℍ → ℂ) z) +
        (physicalExponent (paperOrbitExponent n) / 2) *
          (u : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) z:=

declarations.name: chainRule
declarations.header:
theorem chainRule (D : ExponentIndexedDifferentialCore Γ)
    (a : ℤ) (u : D.core a) :
    RealJetChainRuleCertificate a (u : ℍ → ℂ) :=
  realJetChainRuleCertificate a u.1.2

declarations.name: raise_coe
declarations.header:
theorem raise_coe (D : ExponentIndexedDifferentialCore Γ)
    (a : ℤ) (u : D.core a) :
    (D.raiseCore a u : ℍ → ℂ) = raiseRaw a (u : ℍ → ℂ) :=
  funext (D.raise_apply a u)

declarations.name: lower_coe
declarations.header:
theorem lower_coe (D : ExponentIndexedDifferentialCore Γ)
    (a : ℤ) (u : D.core a) :
    (D.lowerCore a u : ℍ → ℂ) = lowerRaw a (u : ℍ → ℂ) :=
  funext (D.lower_apply a u)

declarations.name: laplace_coe
declarations.header:
theorem laplace_coe (D : ExponentIndexedDifferentialCore Γ)
    (a : ℤ) (u : D.core a) :
    (D.laplaceCore a u : ℍ → ℂ) = laplaceRaw a (u : ℍ → ℂ) :=
  funext (D.laplace_apply a u)

/-- Covariance of every core element, derived from its typed section. -/

declarations.name: covariance
declarations.header:
theorem covariance (D : ExponentIndexedDifferentialCore Γ)
    (a : ℤ) (u : D.core a) (γ : Γ) (z : ℍ) :
    (u : ℍ → ℂ) (γ • z) =
      (D.multiplier a).factor γ z * (u : ℍ → ℂ) z:=

declarations.name: raise_covariance
declarations.header:
theorem raise_covariance (D : ExponentIndexedDifferentialCore Γ)
    (a : ℤ) (u : D.core a) (γ : Γ) (z : ℍ) :
    (D.raiseCore a u : ℍ → ℂ) (γ • z) =
      (D.multiplier (a + 4)).factor γ z *
        (D.raiseCore a u : ℍ → ℂ) z :=
  D.covariance (a + 4) (D.raiseCore a u) γ z

/-- Lowering has the correct target exponent at the type level. -/

declarations.name: lower_covariance
declarations.header:
theorem lower_covariance (D : ExponentIndexedDifferentialCore Γ)
    (a : ℤ) (u : D.core a) (γ : Γ) (z : ℍ) :
    (D.lowerCore a u : ℍ → ℂ) (γ • z) =
      (D.multiplier (a - 4)).factor γ z *
        (D.lowerCore a u : ℍ → ℂ) z :=
  D.covariance (a - 4) (D.lowerCore a u) γ z

/-- Coordinate factorization transported to the typed core. -/

declarations.name: typed_lower_raise_factorization
declarations.header:
theorem typed_lower_raise_factorization
    (D : ExponentIndexedDifferentialCore Γ) (a : ℤ) (u : D.core a)
    (z : ℍ) :
    -(D.laplaceCore a u : ℍ → ℂ) z =
      (D.lowerCore (a + 4) (D.raiseCore a u) : ℍ → ℂ) z +
        physicalExponent a * (u : ℍ → ℂ) z:=

declarations.name: typed_raise_lower_factorization
declarations.header:
theorem typed_raise_lower_factorization
    (D : ExponentIndexedDifferentialCore Γ) (a : ℤ) (u : D.core a)
    (z : ℍ) :
    -(D.laplaceCore a u : ℍ → ℂ) z =
      (D.raiseCore (a - 4) (D.lowerCore a u) : ℍ → ℂ) z:=

/-- The directional derivative remains in the same genuine test-function
core.  This is Mathlib's bundled derivative, not an assumed closure field. -/

  TestFunction.lineDerivCLM ℂ ξ u

/-- The two real coordinate derivatives on the ambient chart. -/

declarations.name: dy_apply

declarations.name: conjugate_apply
declarations.header:
theorem conjugate_apply (u : Core) (w : ℂ) :

declarations.name: rpowScale_contDiffAt_of_im_pos
declarations.header:
theorem rpowScale_contDiffAt_of_im_pos

declarations.name: rpowMul_apply
declarations.header:
theorem rpowMul_apply (p : ℝ) (u : Core) (w : ℂ) :
    rpowMul p u w = rpowScale p w * u w :=
  rfl

/-- Every element of this core, including every bundled derivative and every
weighted product constructed above, vanishes pointwise off the open upper
half-plane. -/

declarations.name: eq_zero_of_not_im_pos
declarations.header:
theorem eq_zero_of_not_im_pos (u : Core) {w : ℂ}
    (hw : ¬ 0 < w.im) : u w = 0:=

declarations.name: fderiv_rpowScale_apply_of_im_pos
declarations.header:
theorem fderiv_rpowScale_apply_of_im_pos
    (p : ℝ) {w ξ : ℂ} (hw : 0 < w.im) :
    fderiv ℝ (rpowScale p) w ξ =
      (((p * w.im ^ (p - 1)) * ξ.im : ℝ) : ℂ):=

declarations.name: directionalDerivative_rpowMul_apply_of_im_pos
declarations.header:
theorem directionalDerivative_rpowMul_apply_of_im_pos
    (p : ℝ) (u : Core) {w ξ : ℂ} (hw : 0 < w.im) :
    directionalDerivative ξ (rpowMul p u) w =
      (((p * w.im ^ (p - 1)) * ξ.im : ℝ) : ℂ) * u w +
        rpowScale p w * directionalDerivative ξ u w:=

declarations.name: dx_rpowMul_apply_of_im_pos
declarations.header:
theorem dx_rpowMul_apply_of_im_pos
    (p : ℝ) (u : Core) {w : ℂ} (hw : 0 < w.im) :
    dx (rpowMul p u) w = rpowScale p w * dx u w:=

declarations.name: dy_rpowMul_apply_of_im_pos
declarations.header:
theorem dy_rpowMul_apply_of_im_pos
    (p : ℝ) (u : Core) {w : ℂ} (hw : 0 < w.im) :
    dy (rpowMul p u) w =
      ((p * w.im ^ (p - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) * u w +
        rpowScale p w * dy u w:=

declarations.name: product_integrable
declarations.header:
theorem product_integrable (u v : Core) :
    Integrable (fun w : ℂ => u w * v w) volume :=
  (u.continuous.mul v.continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
    u.hasCompactSupport.mul_right

/-- The bilinear compact-core pairing used after conjugating and inserting
the Petersson height factor explicitly. -/
noncomputable def compactPair (u v : Core) : ℂ :=
  ∫ w : ℂ, u w * v w

declarations.name: compactPair_add_left
declarations.header:
theorem compactPair_add_left (u v w : Core) :
    compactPair (u + v) w = compactPair u w + compactPair v w:=

declarations.name: compactPair_add_right
declarations.header:
theorem compactPair_add_right (u v w : Core) :
    compactPair u (v + w) = compactPair u v + compactPair u w:=

declarations.name: compactPair_smul_left
declarations.header:
theorem compactPair_smul_left (c : ℂ) (u v : Core) :
    compactPair (c • u) v = c * compactPair u v:=

declarations.name: compactPair_smul_right
declarations.header:
theorem compactPair_smul_right (c : ℂ) (u v : Core) :
    compactPair u (c • v) = c * compactPair u v:=

declarations.name: compactPair_directionalDerivative_right
declarations.header:
theorem compactPair_directionalDerivative_right
    (ξ : ℂ) (u v : Core) :
    compactPair u (directionalDerivative ξ v) =
      -compactPair (directionalDerivative ξ u) v:=

declarations.name: compactPair_directionalDerivative_left
declarations.header:
theorem compactPair_directionalDerivative_left
    (ξ : ℂ) (u v : Core) :
    compactPair (directionalDerivative ξ u) v =
      -compactPair u (directionalDerivative ξ v):=

declarations.name: localizeLeft_apply
declarations.header:
theorem localizeLeft_apply (f : ℍ → ℂ) (hf : RealSmooth f)
    (v : Core) (w : ℂ) :
    localizeLeft f hf v w = upperLift f w * v w :=
  rfl

/-- On the upper-half-plane chart, differentiation of the localized product
is the ordinary product rule. -/

declarations.name: directionalDerivative_localizeLeft_apply
declarations.header:
theorem directionalDerivative_localizeLeft_apply
    (f : ℍ → ℂ) (hf : RealSmooth f) (v : Core)
    (ξ : ℂ) (z : ℍ) :
    directionalDerivative ξ (localizeLeft f hf v) (z : ℂ) =
      d1 f z ξ * v (z : ℂ) +
        f z * directionalDerivative ξ v (z : ℂ):=

declarations.name: core_integrable
declarations.header:
theorem core_integrable (u : Core) :
    Integrable (u : ℂ → ℂ) volume :=
  u.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport u.hasCompactSupport

/-- The integral of a directional derivative of a compact test is zero.  It
is obtained from Mathlib's full-space integration-by-parts theorem with the
constant function in the other factor. -/

declarations.name: integral_directionalDerivative_eq_zero
declarations.header:
theorem integral_directionalDerivative_eq_zero (ξ : ℂ) (u : Core) :
    (∫ w : ℂ, directionalDerivative ξ u w) = 0:=

declarations.name: directionalDerivative_localizeLeft
declarations.header:
theorem directionalDerivative_localizeLeft
    (f : ℍ → ℂ) (hf : RealSmooth f) (v : Core) (ξ : ℂ) :
    directionalDerivative ξ (localizeLeft f hf v) =
      localizeLeft (fun z => d1 f z ξ) (RealSmooth.d1_constDirection hf ξ) v +
        localizeLeft f hf (directionalDerivative ξ v):=

declarations.name: integral_d1_mul_test_eq_neg
declarations.header:
theorem integral_d1_mul_test_eq_neg
    (f : ℍ → ℂ) (hf : RealSmooth f) (v : Core) (ξ : ℂ) :
    (∫ w : ℂ,
        localizeLeft (fun z => d1 f z ξ)
          (RealSmooth.d1_constDirection hf ξ) v w) =
      -(∫ w : ℂ,
        localizeLeft f hf (directionalDerivative ξ v) w):=

declarations.name: integral_dx_mul_test_eq_neg
declarations.header:
theorem integral_dx_mul_test_eq_neg
    (f : ℍ → ℂ) (hf : RealSmooth f) (v : Core) :
    (∫ w : ℂ,
        localizeLeft (HalfWeightDifferentialOperators.dx f)
          (RealSmooth.dx hf) v w) =
      -(∫ w : ℂ, localizeLeft f hf (dx v) w):=

declarations.name: integral_dy_mul_test_eq_neg
declarations.header:
theorem integral_dy_mul_test_eq_neg
    (f : ℍ → ℂ) (hf : RealSmooth f) (v : Core) :
    (∫ w : ℂ,
        localizeLeft (HalfWeightDifferentialOperators.dy f)
          (RealSmooth.dy hf) v w) =
      -(∫ w : ℂ, localizeLeft f hf (dy v) w):=

declarations.name: tsupport_directionalDerivative_subset
declarations.header:
theorem tsupport_directionalDerivative_subset
    (ξ : ℂ) (v : Core) :

      tsupport (v : ℂ → ℂ):=

declarations.name: tsupport_dx_subset
declarations.header:
theorem tsupport_dx_subset (v : Core) :

declarations.name: tsupport_dy_subset

  tsupport_directionalDerivative_subset Complex.I v

/-- Multiplication by a height power cannot enlarge the support of a compact
test. -/

declarations.name: tsupport_rpowMul_subset

theorem tsupport_rpowMul_subset (p : ℝ) (v : Core) :
    tsupport (rpowMul p v : ℂ → ℂ) ⊆ tsupport (v : ℂ → ℂ) :=

/-- Horizontal differentiation commutes with every real height power. -/

declarations.name: dx_rpowMul
declarations.header:
theorem dx_rpowMul (p : ℝ) (v : Core) :
    dx (rpowMul p v) = rpowMul p (dx v):=

declarations.name: dy_rpowMul
declarations.header:
theorem dy_rpowMul (p : ℝ) (v : Core) :
    dy (rpowMul p v) =
      (p : ℂ) • rpowMul (p - 1) v + rpowMul p (dy v):=

declarations.name: integral_rpow_dx_mul_test_eq_neg
declarations.header:
theorem integral_rpow_dx_mul_test_eq_neg
    (p : ℝ) (f : ℍ → ℂ) (hf : RealSmooth f) (v : Core) :
    (∫ w : ℂ,
        localizeLeft (HalfWeightDifferentialOperators.dx f)
          (RealSmooth.dx hf) (rpowMul p v) w) =
      -(∫ w : ℂ,
        localizeLeft f hf (rpowMul p (dx v)) w):=

declarations.name: integral_rpow_dy_mul_test_eq_neg
declarations.header:
theorem integral_rpow_dy_mul_test_eq_neg
    (p : ℝ) (f : ℍ → ℂ) (hf : RealSmooth f) (v : Core) :
    (∫ w : ℂ,
        localizeLeft (HalfWeightDifferentialOperators.dy f)
          (RealSmooth.dy hf) (rpowMul p v) w) =
      -(∫ w : ℂ,
        localizeLeft f hf
          ((p : ℂ) • rpowMul (p - 1) v + rpowMul p (dy v)) w):=

declarations.name: dx_rpowMul_one
declarations.header:
theorem dx_rpowMul_one (v : Core) :
    dx (rpowMul 1 v) = rpowMul 1 (dx v):=

declarations.name: dy_rpowMul_one
declarations.header:
theorem dy_rpowMul_one (v : Core) :
    dy (rpowMul 1 v) = v + rpowMul 1 (dy v):=

declarations.name: integral_height_dx_mul_test_eq_neg
declarations.header:
theorem integral_height_dx_mul_test_eq_neg
    (f : ℍ → ℂ) (hf : RealSmooth f) (v : Core) :
    (∫ w : ℂ,
        localizeLeft (HalfWeightDifferentialOperators.dx f)
          (RealSmooth.dx hf) (rpowMul 1 v) w) =
      -(∫ w : ℂ,
        localizeLeft f hf (rpowMul 1 (dx v)) w):=

declarations.name: integral_height_dy_mul_test_eq_neg
declarations.header:
theorem integral_height_dy_mul_test_eq_neg
    (f : ℍ → ℂ) (hf : RealSmooth f) (v : Core) :
    (∫ w : ℂ,
        localizeLeft (HalfWeightDifferentialOperators.dy f)
          (RealSmooth.dy hf) (rpowMul 1 v) w) =
      -(∫ w : ℂ,
        localizeLeft f hf (v + rpowMul 1 (dy v)) w):=

declarations.name: conj_exponentC
declarations.header:
theorem conj_exponentC (a : ℤ) :
    star (exponentC a) = exponentC a:=

declarations.name: conj_rpowScale
declarations.header:
theorem conj_rpowScale (p : ℝ) (w : ℂ) :
    star (rpowScale p w) = rpowScale p w:=

declarations.name: directionalDerivative_conjugate_apply
declarations.header:
theorem directionalDerivative_conjugate_apply
    (ξ : ℂ) (u : Core) (w : ℂ) :
    directionalDerivative ξ (conjugate u) w =
      star (directionalDerivative ξ u w):=

declarations.name: dx_conjugate_apply
declarations.header:
theorem dx_conjugate_apply (u : Core) (w : ℂ) :
    dx (conjugate u) w = star (dx u w):=

declarations.name: dy_conjugate_apply
declarations.header:
theorem dy_conjugate_apply (u : Core) (w : ℂ) :
    dy (conjugate u) w = star (dy u w):=

declarations.name: raise_apply
declarations.header:
theorem raise_apply (a : ℤ) (u : Core) (w : ℂ) :
    raise a u w =
      Complex.I * dx u w + dy u w +
        exponentC a * rpowScale (-1) w * u w:=

declarations.name: normalizedLower_apply
declarations.header:
theorem normalizedLower_apply (v : Core) (w : ℂ) :
    normalizedLower v w = -Complex.I * dx v w + dy v w:=

declarations.name: lower_apply
declarations.header:
theorem lower_apply (v : Core) (w : ℂ) :
    lower v w = rpowScale 2 w *
      (-Complex.I * dx v w + dy v w):=

declarations.name: weightedConjugate_apply
declarations.header:
theorem weightedConjugate_apply (a : ℤ) (u : Core) (w : ℂ) :
    weightedConjugate a u w =
      rpowScale (exponentR a) w * star (u w):=

declarations.name: dx_weightedConjugate_apply_of_im_pos
declarations.header:
theorem dx_weightedConjugate_apply_of_im_pos
    (a : ℤ) (u : Core) {w : ℂ} (hw : 0 < w.im) :
    dx (weightedConjugate a u) w =
      rpowScale (exponentR a) w * star (dx u w):=

declarations.name: dy_weightedConjugate_apply_of_im_pos
declarations.header:
theorem dy_weightedConjugate_apply_of_im_pos
    (a : ℤ) (u : Core) {w : ℂ} (hw : 0 < w.im) :
    dy (weightedConjugate a u) w =
      ((exponentR a * w.im ^ (exponentR a - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          star (u w) +
        rpowScale (exponentR a) w * star (dy u w):=

declarations.name: weighted_inverse_height_coefficient
declarations.header:
theorem weighted_inverse_height_coefficient
    (a : ℤ) {w : ℂ} (hw : 0 < w.im) :
    rpowScale (exponentR a) w *
        (exponentC a * rpowScale (-1) w) =
      ((exponentR a * w.im ^ (exponentR a - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ):=

declarations.name: weightedConjugate_raise_eq_flux
declarations.header:
theorem weightedConjugate_raise_eq_flux (a : ℤ) (u : Core) :
    weightedConjugate a (raise a u) =
      (-Complex.I) • dx (weightedConjugate a u) +
        dy (weightedConjugate a u):=

declarations.name: compact_green_identity
declarations.header:
theorem compact_green_identity (a : ℤ) (u v : Core) :
    compactPair (weightedConjugate a (raise a u)) v =
      -compactPair (weightedConjugate a u) (normalizedLower v):=

declarations.name: compact_green_sum_eq_zero
declarations.header:
theorem compact_green_sum_eq_zero (a : ℤ) (u v : Core) :
    compactPair (weightedConjugate a (raise a u)) v +
        compactPair (weightedConjugate a u) (normalizedLower v) = 0:=

declarations.name: compactPair_rpowMul_left_eq_right
declarations.header:
theorem compactPair_rpowMul_left_eq_right
    (p : ℝ) (u v : Core) :
    compactPair (rpowMul p u) v = compactPair u (rpowMul p v):=

declarations.name: weightedConjugate_normalizedLower_eq_flux
declarations.header:
theorem weightedConjugate_normalizedLower_eq_flux
    (a : ℤ) (u : Core) :
    weightedConjugate a (normalizedLower u) =
      Complex.I • dx (weightedConjugate a u) +
        dy (weightedConjugate a u) +
        (-exponentC a) • rpowMul (-1) (weightedConjugate a u):=

declarations.name: compact_lowering_green_identity
declarations.header:
theorem compact_lowering_green_identity (a : ℤ) (u v : Core) :
    compactPair (weightedConjugate a (normalizedLower u)) v =
      -compactPair (weightedConjugate a u) (raise a v):=

declarations.name: compact_lowering_green_sum_eq_zero
declarations.header:
theorem compact_lowering_green_sum_eq_zero (a : ℤ) (u v : Core) :
    compactPair (weightedConjugate a (normalizedLower u)) v +
        compactPair (weightedConjugate a u) (raise a v) = 0:=

declarations.name: compact_green_half_average_eq_zero
declarations.header:
theorem compact_green_half_average_eq_zero (a : ℤ) (u v : Core) :
    (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
        (compactPair (weightedConjugate a (raise a u)) v +
          compactPair (weightedConjugate a u) (normalizedLower v)) +
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
        (compactPair (weightedConjugate a (normalizedLower u)) v +
          compactPair (weightedConjugate a u) (raise a v)) = 0:=

declarations.name: compact_green_identity_expanded
declarations.header:
theorem compact_green_identity_expanded (a : ℤ) (u v : Core) :
    (∫ w : ℂ,
      rpowScale (exponentR a) w * star (raise a u w) * v w) =
      -(∫ w : ℂ,
        rpowScale (exponentR a) w * star (u w) *
          normalizedLower v w):=

declarations.name: upperLift_restrictToUpper_eqOn
declarations.header:
theorem upperLift_restrictToUpper_eqOn (u : Core) :
    Set.EqOn (upperLift (restrictToUpper u)) (u : ℂ → ℂ)
      UpperHalfPlane.upperHalfPlaneSet:=

declarations.name: restrictToUpper_realSmooth
declarations.header:
theorem restrictToUpper_realSmooth (u : Core) :
    RealSmooth (restrictToUpper u):=

declarations.name: upperLift_restrictToUpper_eventuallyEq
declarations.header:
theorem upperLift_restrictToUpper_eventuallyEq
    (u : Core) (z : ℍ) :
    upperLift (restrictToUpper u) =ᶠ[nhds (z : ℂ)] (u : ℂ → ℂ):=

declarations.name: raw_dx_restrictToUpper
declarations.header:
theorem raw_dx_restrictToUpper (u : Core) (z : ℍ) :
    HalfWeightDifferentialOperators.dx (restrictToUpper u) z =
      dx u (z : ℂ):=

declarations.name: raw_dy_restrictToUpper
declarations.header:
theorem raw_dy_restrictToUpper (u : Core) (z : ℍ) :
    HalfWeightDifferentialOperators.dy (restrictToUpper u) z =
      dy u (z : ℂ):=

declarations.name: rpowScale_eq_weightFiberScale
declarations.header:
theorem rpowScale_eq_weightFiberScale
    (a : ℤ) {w : ℂ} (hw : 0 < w.im) :
    rpowScale (exponentR a) w =
      (weightFiberScale (-a) (UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex w) : ℂ):=

declarations.name: restrictToUpper_raise
declarations.header:
theorem restrictToUpper_raise (a : ℤ) (u : Core) (z : ℍ) :
    restrictToUpper (raise a u) z =
      raiseRaw a (restrictToUpper u) z:=

declarations.name: restrictToUpper_lower
declarations.header:
theorem restrictToUpper_lower (a : ℤ) (v : Core) (z : ℍ) :
    restrictToUpper (lower v) z =
      lowerRaw a (restrictToUpper v) z:=

declarations.name: normalizedLower_eq_lowerRaw_div_heightSq
declarations.header:
theorem normalizedLower_eq_lowerRaw_div_heightSq
    (a : ℤ) (v : Core) (z : ℍ) :
    normalizedLower v (z : ℂ) =
      lowerRaw a (restrictToUpper v) z / heightC z ^ 2:=

declarations.name: coordinate_lower_raise_factorization
declarations.header:
theorem coordinate_lower_raise_factorization
    (a : ℤ) (u : Core) (z : ℍ) :
    -laplaceRaw a (restrictToUpper u) z =
      restrictToUpper (lower (raise a u)) z +
        physicalExponent a * restrictToUpper u z:=

declarations.name: coordinate_raise_lower_factorization
declarations.header:
theorem coordinate_raise_lower_factorization
    (a : ℤ) (u : Core) (z : ℍ) :
    -laplaceRaw a (restrictToUpper u) z =
      restrictToUpper (raise (a - 4) (lower u)) z:=

declarations.name: coordinate_averaged_factorization
declarations.header:
theorem coordinate_averaged_factorization
    (a : ℤ) (u : Core) (z : ℍ) :
    -laplaceRaw a (restrictToUpper u) z =
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
        (restrictToUpper (lower (raise a u)) z +
          restrictToUpper (raise (a - 4) (lower u)) z) +
      (physicalExponent a / 2) * restrictToUpper u z:=

declarations.name: ambientCcInfinity_raising_green_identity
declarations.header:
theorem ambientCcInfinity_raising_green_identity
    (a : ℤ) (u v : Core) :
    compactPair (weightedConjugate a (raise a u)) v =
      -compactPair (weightedConjugate a u) (normalizedLower v) :=
  compact_green_identity a u v

/-- Lowering Green identity on the genuine ambient `C_c^∞(ℍ)` core. -/

declarations.name: ambientCcInfinity_lowering_green_identity
declarations.header:
theorem ambientCcInfinity_lowering_green_identity
    (a : ℤ) (u v : Core) :
    compactPair (weightedConjugate a (normalizedLower u)) v =
      -compactPair (weightedConjugate a u) (raise a v) :=
  compact_lowering_green_identity a u v

/-- Exact half-average on the genuine ambient `C_c^∞(ℍ)` core. -/

declarations.name: ambientCcInfinity_green_half_average_eq_zero
declarations.header:
theorem ambientCcInfinity_green_half_average_eq_zero
    (a : ℤ) (u v : Core) :
    (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
        (compactPair (weightedConjugate a (raise a u)) v +
          compactPair (weightedConjugate a u) (normalizedLower v)) +
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
        (compactPair (weightedConjugate a (normalizedLower u)) v +
          compactPair (weightedConjugate a u) (raise a v)) = 0 :=
  compact_green_half_average_eq_zero a u v

/-!
Honesty boundary.  `Core` has compact support in the ambient upper half-plane.
An automorphic fixed-phase lift instead repeats along every `Gamma(2)` orbit
and has only *quotient*-compact support, so there is intentionally no coercion
from `InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n` to `Core`.  Consequently the theorems above
do not assert `FixedPhasePeterssonCoordinates.greenBoundaryDefect = 0` on the
quotient.  That final statement still requires polygonal Stokes, paired-side
cancellation, and horocycle trace/decay; nullity of the geometric boundary
alone is not an integration-by-parts theorem.
-/

end

end HalfWeightCompactCoordinateGreen

/-! ### 6.5.2: exact missing quotient-Stokes statements

Mathlib contains the full-space integration-by-parts theorem used in
`HalfWeightCompactCoordinateGreen`, and rectangular divergence theorems such
as `MeasureTheory.integral_divergence_prod_Icc_of_hasFDerivAt_of_le`.  The
latter applies to a Cartesian rectangle with four explicitly parametrized
edges.  The selected `Gamma(2)` carrier is instead a finite union of Möbius
images of the modular tile; its boundary contains circular arcs, paired
vertical sides, and cusp horocycles.  The current modular API supplies these
sets, their point parametrizations, orientation signs, pairing maps, and
finite corner deletion.  It does not yet supply the derivative/tangent form
of those parametrizations or a curvilinear change-of-variables theorem that
identifies the tile area integral with the resulting one-dimensional flux
sum.  Thus the rectangular theorem cannot be instantiated merely by
rewriting sets.

The declarations below state the precise lower-level theorem that is missing.
They do not add a certificate to a differential core and do not repackage the
desired Petersson equality as a hypothesis.  Instead they expose the
coordinate flux one-form, its pullback law under `Gamma(2)`, and the actual
Euclidean-divergence integral (written against hyperbolic measure with the
Jacobian factor `y²`).
-/

namespace GammaTwoQuotientGreenBoundary

open MeasureTheory Set
open HalfWeightDifferentialOperators
open GammaTwoQuotientGeometry
open SmoothCompactCoreGeometry

/-- Every real power of the positive height, complexified, is real smooth on
the upper half-plane. -/

declarations.name: realSmooth_complexHeightRpow
declarations.header:
theorem realSmooth_complexHeightRpow (p : ℝ) :
    RealSmooth (fun z : ℍ => ((z.im ^ p : ℝ) : ℂ)):=

declarations.name: d1_complexHeightRpow
declarations.header:

/-- Closed-carrier compact-preimage properness is sufficient for the exact
literal `F_Y` tail statement.  This reduction uses the already-proved theorem

/-- The second precise missing implication: polygonal divergence plus
oriented cancellation of every paired side.  The tail hypothesis has already
removed the high horocycles, while `IsGammaTwoInvariantFlux` is exactly the
pullback identity needed on paired sides.

The factor `heightC z ^ 2` converts hyperbolic area `dx dy / y²` back to
Euclidean area, so the integrand is literally `∂x X + ∂y Y`. -/
def GammaTwoPairedPolygonFluxStokes : Prop :=
  ∀ (X Y : ℍ → ℂ),
    IsSmoothQuotientCompactFlux X Y →
    HasZeroThreeCuspTail X Y →
    IntegrableOn
      (fun z => heightC z ^ 2 * (dx X z + dy Y z))
      chosenGammaTwoFundamentalDomain.carrier hyperbolicMeasure →
    (∫ z in chosenGammaTwoFundamentalDomain.carrier,
      heightC z ^ 2 * (dx X z + dy Y z)
        ∂hyperbolicMeasure) = 0

/-- Combined compact-flux Stokes endpoint.  This is the exact lower-level
statement required before applying the pointwise Green bulk expansion. -/
def GammaTwoCompactFluxStokes : Prop :=
  ∀ (X Y : ℍ → ℂ),
    IsSmoothQuotientCompactFlux X Y →
    IntegrableOn
      (fun z => heightC z ^ 2 * (dx X z + dy Y z))
      chosenGammaTwoFundamentalDomain.carrier hyperbolicMeasure →
    (∫ z in chosenGammaTwoFundamentalDomain.carrier,
      heightC z ^ 2 * (dx X z + dy Y z)
        ∂hyperbolicMeasure) = 0

endpoint without any further certificate. -/

following one-field structure is intentionally opaque rather than a reducible
type synonym.  Consequently the Petersson norm and inner-product instances
installed below cannot leak back to the original subtype through definitional
equality.
-/

/-- An opaque copy of the shifted-weight compact core reserved for the
Petersson norm. -/
structure PeterssonCoreSpace where

/-! #### Fixed-phase differential coordinates in the Petersson completions

The canonical stable core from 6.5 now has a faithful coordinate in every
shifted Petersson Hilbert completion.  Composing those coordinates with the
actual typed `R` and `L` maps gives the three algebraic graph coordinates
needed later.  Continuity/closability is deliberately not inferred from this
algebraic construction: that is exactly what the global Green identity must
establish.
-/

namespace FixedPhasePeterssonCoordinates

open MeasureTheory
open HalfIntegralMultiplier HalfWeightDifferentialOperators
  GammaTwoQuotientGeometry
open GammaTwoQuotientGreenBoundary
open SmoothCompactCoreGeometry
open WeightCorePetersson WeightCorePetersson.PeterssonCoreSpace

noncomputable abbrev OrbitMultiplier (n : ℤ) :=
  inverseEtaPaperOrbitMultiplier GammaTwo n

abbrev OrbitPeterssonCore (n : ℤ) :=
  PeterssonCoreSpace (OrbitMultiplier n)

abbrev OrbitPeterssonHilbert (n : ℤ) :=
  PeterssonHilbertCompletion (OrbitMultiplier n)

/-- Faithful algebraic embedding of the fixed-phase differential core into
the norm-carrying Petersson core at the same shifted weight. -/
noncomputable def coreEmbedding (n : ℤ) :
    InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n →ₗ[ℂ] OrbitPeterssonCore n :=
  ((PeterssonCoreSpace.coreLinearEquiv (OrbitMultiplier n)).symm.toLinearMap).comp
    (InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore.toSmoothCompactWeightCore n)

@[simp]

declarations.name: coreEmbedding_toSmoothCore
declarations.header:
theorem coreEmbedding_toSmoothCore (n : ℤ)
    (u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) :
    (coreEmbedding n u).toSmoothCore =
      InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore.toSmoothCompactWeightCore n u :=
  rfl

declarations.header:
theorem coreEmbedding_injective (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (coreEmbedding n):=

declarations.header:
theorem l2Coordinate_apply (n : ℤ)
    (u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) :
    l2Coordinate n u =
      PeterssonCoreSpace.toCompletion (coreEmbedding n u) :=
  rfl

declarations.name: l2Coordinate_injective
declarations.header:
theorem l2Coordinate_injective (n : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (l2Coordinate n):=

declarations.header:
theorem raisedCoordinate_apply (n : ℤ)

theorem loweredCoordinate_apply (n : ℤ)

/-! The exact remaining Green/Stokes boundary

`normalizedGreenBulk_expansion` proves the complete pointwise bulk formula.
The quantity below is the global Petersson defect for a compact-core pair.
Proving that it vanishes is *not* an algebraic multiplier question: it requires
a Stokes/divergence theorem on the chosen `Gamma(2)` fundamental region,
cancellation of paired sides, and control of the horocycle/corner boundary.
No field or certificate below assumes that theorem.
-/

/-- Exact global defect in the desired identity
`<R_n u,v> = -<u,L_{n+1}v>`. -/
noncomputable def greenBoundaryDefect (n : ℤ)
    (u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n)
    (v : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore (n + 1)) : ℂ :=
  peterssonForm (OrbitMultiplier (n + 1))
      chosenGammaTwoFundamentalDomain
      (InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore.toSmoothCompactWeightCore (n + 1)
        (InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore.raise n u))
      (InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore.toSmoothCompactWeightCore (n + 1) v) +
    peterssonForm (OrbitMultiplier n)
      chosenGammaTwoFundamentalDomain
      (InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore.toSmoothCompactWeightCore n u)
      (InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore.toSmoothCompactWeightCore n
        (InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore.lowerFromSucc n v))

/-! The actual fixed-phase flux behind the defect

For source doubled exponent `a`, put
`rho = y^(a/2) * conj(u) * v`.  The Green bulk formula is
`-i ∂x rho + ∂y rho`, hence the oriented one-form is
`(-i rho) dy - rho dx`.  The following functions record this concrete flux;
they are not existential boundary certificates. -/

/-- The explicit scalar coefficient `rho` of the fixed-phase Green flux. -/
noncomputable def fixedPhaseGreenScalarDensity (n : ℤ)
    (u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n)
    (v : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore (n + 1)) : ℍ → ℂ :=
  fun z =>
    ((weightFiberScale (-paperOrbitExponent n) z : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      star
        ((u : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) z) *
      ((v : SmoothQuotientCompactFunction) z)

/-- Public form of the exact cancellation between the source Hermitian fiber
metric and the conjugate/source multiplier pair.  This isolates the
conjugation slot: the source factor occurs as `conj F * F`, not as `F * F` or
as two target factors. -/

declarations.name: fixedPhaseGreen_sourceFiberFactor_cancellation
declarations.header:
theorem fixedPhaseGreen_sourceFiberFactor_cancellation (n : ℤ)
    (γ : GammaTwo) (z : ℍ) :
    ((weightFiberScale (-paperOrbitExponent n)
        (((γ : GammaTwo) : SL(2, ℤ)) • z) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (star ((OrbitMultiplier n).factor γ z) *
          (OrbitMultiplier n).factor γ z) =
      ((weightFiberScale (-paperOrbitExponent n) z : ℝ) : ℂ):=

declarations.name: fixedPhaseGreen_targetFactor_reindex
declarations.header:
theorem fixedPhaseGreen_targetFactor_reindex (n : ℤ)
    (γ : GammaTwo) (z : ℍ) :
    (OrbitMultiplier (n + 1)).factor γ z =
      (OrbitMultiplier n).factor γ z *
        inverseEtaPaperOrbitDenom γ z ^ 2:=

declarations.name: fixedPhaseGreenScalarDensity_covariance
declarations.header:
theorem fixedPhaseGreenScalarDensity_covariance (n : ℤ)
    (u : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n)
    (v : InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore (n + 1))
    (γ : GammaTwo) (z : ℍ) :
    fixedPhaseGreenScalarDensity n u v
        (((γ : GammaTwo) : SL(2, ℤ)) • z) =
      inverseEtaPaperOrbitDenom γ z ^ 2 *
        fixedPhaseGreenScalarDensity n u v z:=

declarations.name: weightFiberScale_neg_eq_heightRpow
declarations.header:
theorem weightFiberScale_neg_eq_heightRpow (a : ℤ) (z : ℍ) :
    weightFiberScale (-a) z = z.im ^ ((a : ℝ) / 2):=

declarations.name: fixedPhaseGreenScale_eq_heightRpow
declarations.header:
theorem fixedPhaseGreenScale_eq_heightRpow (n : ℤ) (z : ℍ) :
    fixedPhaseGreenScale n z =
      ((z.im ^ (((paperOrbitExponent n : ℤ) : ℝ) / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ):=

declarations.name: fixedPhaseGreenScale_realSmooth
declarations.header:
theorem fixedPhaseGreenScale_realSmooth (n : ℤ) :
    SmoothCompactCoreGeometry.RealSmooth (fixedPhaseGreenScale n):=

declarations.name: dx_fixedPhaseGreenScale
declarations.header:
theorem dx_fixedPhaseGreenScale (n : ℤ) (z : ℍ) :
    dx (fixedPhaseGreenScale n) z = 0:=

declarations.name: dy_fixedPhaseGreenScale
declarations.header:
theorem dy_fixedPhaseGreenScale (n : ℤ) (z : ℍ) :
