declarations.name: smoothCoreIsOperatorCore_iff_graphClosure
declarations.header:
theorem smoothCoreIsOperatorCore_iff_graphClosure
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) :
    SmoothCoreIsOperatorCore n t ↔
      (minimalStrongSchrodinger n t).graph.topologicalClosure =
        (modularAssociatedOperator n t).graph:=

declarations.name: closure_eq_associated_iff_closure_eq_maximal
declarations.header:
theorem closure_eq_associated_iff_closure_eq_maximal
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) :
    (minimalStrongSchrodinger n t).closure =
        modularAssociatedOperator n t ↔
      (minimalStrongSchrodinger n t).closure =
        maximalStrongSchrodinger n t:=

declarations.name: smoothCore_operatorCore_iff_minimal_eq_maximal
declarations.header:
theorem smoothCore_operatorCore_iff_minimal_eq_maximal
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) :
    SmoothCoreIsOperatorCore n t ↔
      (minimalStrongSchrodinger n t).closure =
        maximalStrongSchrodinger n t:=

declarations.name: not_smoothCoreIsOperatorCore_of_closure_ne_maximal
declarations.header:

      maximalStrongSchrodinger n t) :
    ¬ SmoothCoreIsOperatorCore n t:=

declarations.name: mem_partialEigenspace_iff
declarations.header:
theorem mem_partialEigenspace_iff
    (A : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) (μ : ℂ) (x : H) :
    x ∈ partialEigenspace A μ ↔
      ∃ hx : x ∈ A.domain, A ⟨x, hx⟩ = μ • x :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- A partial eigenvalue means that its literal partial eigenspace contains a
nonzero vector. -/
def HasPartialEigenvalue (A : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) (μ : ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ x : H, x ≠ 0 ∧ x ∈ partialEigenspace A μ

/-- Formal self-adjointness forces every partial eigenvalue to be fixed by
complex conjugation. -/

declarations.name: conj_eq_self_of_hasPartialEigenvalue
declarations.header:
theorem conj_eq_self_of_hasPartialEigenvalue
    {A : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H} (hA : A.IsFormalAdjoint A)
    {μ : ℂ} (hμ : HasPartialEigenvalue A μ) :
    star μ = μ:=

declarations.name: im_eq_zero_of_hasPartialEigenvalue
declarations.header:
theorem im_eq_zero_of_hasPartialEigenvalue
    {A : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H} (hA : A.IsFormalAdjoint A)
    {μ : ℂ} (hμ : HasPartialEigenvalue A μ) :
    μ.im = 0:=

declarations.name: inner_eq_zero_of_mem_partialEigenspaces
declarations.header:
theorem inner_eq_zero_of_mem_partialEigenspaces
    {A : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H} (hA : A.IsFormalAdjoint A)
    {μ ν : ℂ} (hμν : star μ ≠ ν)
    {x y : H}
    (hx : x ∈ partialEigenspace A μ)
    (hy : y ∈ partialEigenspace A ν) :
    inner ℂ x y = 0:=

declarations.name: inner_eq_zero_of_distinct_partialEigenvalues
declarations.header:
theorem inner_eq_zero_of_distinct_partialEigenvalues
    {A : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H} (hA : A.IsFormalAdjoint A)
    {μ ν : ℂ}
    (hμ : HasPartialEigenvalue A μ)
    (hν : HasPartialEigenvalue A ν)
    (hμν : μ ≠ ν)
    {x y : H}
    (hx : x ∈ partialEigenspace A μ)
    (hy : y ∈ partialEigenspace A ν) :
    inner ℂ x y = 0:=

declarations.name: modularAssociatedOperator_eigenvalue_conj_eq_self
declarations.header:
theorem modularAssociatedOperator_eigenvalue_conj_eq_self
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) {μ : ℂ}
    (hμ : HasPartialEigenvalue (modularAssociatedOperator n t) μ) :
    star μ = μ :=
  conj_eq_self_of_hasPartialEigenvalue
    (modularAssociatedOperator_isFormalAdjoint n t) hμ

declarations.name: modularAssociatedOperator_eigenvalue_im_eq_zero
declarations.header:
theorem modularAssociatedOperator_eigenvalue_im_eq_zero
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) {μ : ℂ}
    (hμ : HasPartialEigenvalue (modularAssociatedOperator n t) μ) :
    μ.im = 0 :=
  im_eq_zero_of_hasPartialEigenvalue
    (modularAssociatedOperator_isFormalAdjoint n t) hμ

/-- Distinct point-spectral subspaces of the actual Petersson realization are
orthogonal in the literal Petersson Hilbert inner product. -/

declarations.name: modularAssociatedOperator_distinct_eigenspaces_orthogonal
declarations.header:
theorem modularAssociatedOperator_distinct_eigenspaces_orthogonal
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) {μ ν : ℂ}
    (hμ : HasPartialEigenvalue (modularAssociatedOperator n t) μ)
    (hν : HasPartialEigenvalue (modularAssociatedOperator n t) ν)
    (hμν : μ ≠ ν)
    {x y : OrbitPeterssonHilbert n}
    (hx : x ∈ partialEigenspace (modularAssociatedOperator n t) μ)
    (hy : y ∈ partialEigenspace (modularAssociatedOperator n t) ν) :
    inner ℂ x y = 0 :=
  inner_eq_zero_of_distinct_partialEigenvalues
    (modularAssociatedOperator_isFormalAdjoint n t)
    hμ hν hμν hx hy

/-- The concrete coercive mass shift gives a genuine lower bound for every
point-spectral value.  This is stronger than reality/orthogonality, but still
does not assert that the whole spectrum is discrete. -/

declarations.name: modularAssociatedOperator_eigenvalue_re_lower_bound
declarations.header:
theorem modularAssociatedOperator_eigenvalue_re_lower_bound
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) {μ : ℂ}
    (hμ : HasPartialEigenvalue (modularAssociatedOperator n t) μ) :
    -discriminantMassShift t ≤ μ.re:=

declarations.name: literalStagePartition_isSubordinate

theorem literalStagePartition_isSubordinate (Y : ℝ) :

declarations.name: literalStagePartition_hasCompactSupport
declarations.header:
theorem literalStagePartition_hasCompactSupport (Y : ℝ) (z : ℍ) :

    (exists_smoothPartitionOfUnity_gammaTwoReducedChart
      (gammaTwoThreeCuspTruncation_isCompact Y))).2.1 z

/-- Exactly the partition members whose topological support meets the literal
stage.  This set is finite by local finiteness on a compact set. -/
def literalStageActiveCenterSet (Y : ℝ) : Set ℍ :=
  {z : ℍ |
    (tsupport (literalStagePartition Y z : ℂ → ℝ) ∩
      (UpperHalfPlane.coe '' gammaTwoThreeCuspTruncation Y)).Nonempty}

declarations.name: literalStageActiveCenterSet_finite
declarations.header:
theorem literalStageActiveCenterSet_finite (Y : ℝ) :
    (literalStageActiveCenterSet Y).Finite :=
  (Classical.choose_spec
    (exists_smoothPartitionOfUnity_gammaTwoReducedChart
      (gammaTwoThreeCuspTruncation_isCompact Y))).2.2

/-- The active center set as a literal finite index set. -/
noncomputable def literalStageActiveCenters (Y : ℝ) : Finset ℍ :=
  (literalStageActiveCenterSet_finite Y).toFinset

@[simp]

    {z : ℍ} (hz : z ∈ gammaTwoThreeCuspTruncation Y) :

    tsupport (literalStageLocalizedGauge Y n u : ℂ → ℂ) ⊆

/-- One honest uniform bound for the cutoff and its two real derivatives.
The constant is extracted from compact support and continuity, rather than
stored as a bounded-geometry field. -/

declarations.name: exists_literalStageCutoffC1Bound
declarations.header:
theorem exists_literalStageCutoffC1Bound (Y : ℝ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ w : ℂ,
      ‖literalStageCutoff Y w‖ ≤ C ∧
      ‖HalfWeightCompactCoordinateGreen.dx (literalStageCutoff Y) w‖ ≤ C ∧
      ‖HalfWeightCompactCoordinateGreen.dy (literalStageCutoff Y) w‖ ≤ C:=

declarations.name: literalStageCutoffC1Bound_nonneg
declarations.header:
theorem literalStageCutoffC1Bound_nonneg (Y : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ literalStageCutoffC1Bound Y :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_literalStageCutoffC1Bound Y)).1

declarations.name: norm_literalStageCutoff_le
declarations.header:
theorem norm_literalStageCutoff_le (Y : ℝ) (w : ℂ) :
    ‖literalStageCutoff Y w‖ ≤ literalStageCutoffC1Bound Y :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_literalStageCutoffC1Bound Y)).2 w |>.1

declarations.name: norm_dx_literalStageCutoff_le
declarations.header:
theorem norm_dx_literalStageCutoff_le (Y : ℝ) (w : ℂ) :
    ‖HalfWeightCompactCoordinateGreen.dx (literalStageCutoff Y) w‖ ≤
      literalStageCutoffC1Bound Y :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_literalStageCutoffC1Bound Y)).2 w |>.2.1

declarations.name: norm_dy_literalStageCutoff_le
declarations.header:
theorem norm_dy_literalStageCutoff_le (Y : ℝ) (w : ℂ) :
    ‖HalfWeightCompactCoordinateGreen.dy (literalStageCutoff Y) w‖ ≤
      literalStageCutoffC1Bound Y :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_literalStageCutoffC1Bound Y)).2 w |>.2.2

/-! ### Positive height on the whole localization support

The derivative product rule is used on `tsupport χ_Y`, rather than merely on
the smaller set `F_Y`.  We therefore extract its own positive lower height.
This is the small but essential buffer which prevents division by the height
from becoming a hidden premise in the planar `H¹` estimate. -/

/-- The compact support of the paired-side-safe localization has a positive
lower height.  The empty-support case is included. -/

declarations.name: exists_literalStageCutoffSupport_height_bounds
declarations.header:
theorem exists_literalStageCutoffSupport_height_bounds (Y : ℝ) :
    ∃ y₀ y₁ : ℝ, 0 < y₀ ∧
      ∀ w ∈ tsupport (literalStageCutoff Y : ℂ → ℂ),
        y₀ ≤ w.im ∧ w.im ≤ y₁:=

declarations.name: literalStageCutoffSupportLowerHeight_pos
declarations.header:
theorem literalStageCutoffSupportLowerHeight_pos (Y : ℝ) :
    0 < literalStageCutoffSupportLowerHeight Y :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
    (exists_literalStageCutoffSupport_height_bounds Y))).1

declarations.name: literalStageCutoffSupport_height_mem_Icc
declarations.header:
theorem literalStageCutoffSupport_height_mem_Icc (Y : ℝ) {w : ℂ}
    (hw : w ∈ tsupport (literalStageCutoff Y : ℂ → ℂ)) :
    w.im ∈ Set.Icc (literalStageCutoffSupportLowerHeight Y)
      (literalStageCutoffSupportUpperHeight Y) :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
    (exists_literalStageCutoffSupport_height_bounds Y))).2 w hw

declarations.name: literalStageCutoffSupportLowerHeight_le_im
declarations.header:
theorem literalStageCutoffSupportLowerHeight_le_im (Y : ℝ) {w : ℂ}
    (hw : w ∈ tsupport (literalStageCutoff Y : ℂ → ℂ)) :
    literalStageCutoffSupportLowerHeight Y ≤ w.im :=
  (literalStageCutoffSupport_height_mem_Icc Y hw).1

/-! ### Exact product rules for the localized physical gauge -/

/-- Horizontal derivative of the actual localized gauge, evaluated upstairs.
This is a specialization of the already proved one-sided compact-localization
product rule. -/

declarations.name: dx_literalStageLocalizedGauge_apply_upper
declarations.header:
theorem dx_literalStageLocalizedGauge_apply_upper
    (Y : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (u : Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.HalfWeightDifferentialOperators.InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) (z : ℍ) :
    HalfWeightCompactCoordinateGreen.dx
        (literalStageLocalizedGauge Y n u) (z : ℂ) =
      dx (fixedPhaseEuclideanGauge n u) z * literalStageCutoff Y (z : ℂ) +
        fixedPhaseEuclideanGauge n u z *
          HalfWeightCompactCoordinateGreen.dx
            (literalStageCutoff Y) (z : ℂ):=

declarations.name: dy_literalStageLocalizedGauge_apply_upper
declarations.header:
theorem dy_literalStageLocalizedGauge_apply_upper
    (Y : ℝ) (n : ℤ) (u : Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev.HalfWeightDifferentialOperators.InverseEtaFixedPhaseCore n) (z : ℍ) :
    HalfWeightCompactCoordinateGreen.dy
        (literalStageLocalizedGauge Y n u) (z : ℂ) =
      dy (fixedPhaseEuclideanGauge n u) z * literalStageCutoff Y (z : ℂ) +
        fixedPhaseEuclideanGauge n u z *
          HalfWeightCompactCoordinateGreen.dy
            (literalStageCutoff Y) (z : ℂ):=

declarations.name: exists_literalStage_height_bounds
declarations.header:
theorem exists_literalStage_height_bounds (Y : ℝ) :
    ∃ y₀ y₁ : ℝ, 0 < y₀ ∧
      ∀ z ∈ gammaTwoThreeCuspTruncation Y,

declarations.name: literalStageLowerHeight_pos
declarations.header:

declarations.name: literalStage_height_mem_Icc

theorem literalStage_height_mem_Icc (Y : ℝ)

    z.im ∈ Set.Icc (literalStageLowerHeight Y)

    (exists_literalStage_height_bounds Y))).2 z hz

declarations.name: literalStageLowerHeight_le_im
declarations.header:
theorem literalStageLowerHeight_le_im (Y : ℝ)
    {z : ℍ} (hz : z ∈ gammaTwoThreeCuspTruncation Y) :

  (literalStage_height_mem_Icc Y hz).1

theorem im_le_literalStageUpperHeight (Y : ℝ)

/-! ### Exact graph-density control of the two Euclidean derivatives -/

/-- The zero-order coefficient already used in the trace estimate is at
least three.  This elementary fact lets the same graph density dominate the
ordinary vertical derivative without changing its definition. -/

declarations.name: three_le_logHeightTraceBaseCoeff
declarations.header:
theorem three_le_logHeightTraceBaseCoeff (n : ℤ) :
    3 ≤ logHeightTraceBaseCoeff n:=

declarations.name: three_quarters_horizontalDrift_sq_le_baseCoeff

/-! #### A fixed rectangle and its genuine Fourier modes

The following rectangle is chosen from the compact support of `χ_Y`.  Its
side length is four times a positive support radius.  Consequently every
localized gauge is supported in the *interior half* of the rectangle.  This
strict buffer is what makes the half-open fundamental-box representative
periodic without a boundary term. -/

declarations.name: exists_literalStageFourierRadius
declarations.header:
theorem exists_literalStageFourierRadius (Y : ℝ) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧
      tsupport (literalStageCutoff Y : ℂ → ℂ) ⊆ Metric.ball 0 R:=

declarations.name: literalStageFourierRadius_pos
declarations.header:
theorem literalStageFourierRadius_pos (Y : ℝ) :
    0 < literalStageFourierRadius Y :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_literalStageFourierRadius Y)).1

declarations.name: tsupport_literalStageCutoff_subset_fourierBall
declarations.header:
theorem tsupport_literalStageCutoff_subset_fourierBall (Y : ℝ) :
    tsupport (literalStageCutoff Y : ℂ → ℂ) ⊆
      Metric.ball 0 (literalStageFourierRadius Y) :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_literalStageFourierRadius Y)).2

/-- Side length of the Fourier rectangle. -/
noncomputable def literalStageFourierScale (Y : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  4 * literalStageFourierRadius Y

declarations.name: literalStageFourierScale_pos
declarations.header:
theorem literalStageFourierScale_pos (Y : ℝ) :
    0 < literalStageFourierScale Y:=

declarations.header:
theorem literalStageFourierScale_ne_zero (Y : ℝ) :
    literalStageFourierScale Y ≠ 0 :=
  (literalStageFourierScale_pos Y).ne'

/-- Half-open physical fundamental rectangle.  The half-open convention is
the one used by `UnitAddTorus.measurableEquivPiIoc`. -/
def literalStageFourierBox (Y : ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  {w | ∀ i : Fin 2,
    Complex.measurableEquivPi w i ∈
      Set.Ioc (-(literalStageFourierScale Y / 2))
        (literalStageFourierScale Y / 2)}

/-! ##### The actual compact quotient stage and its carrier lift -/

/-- Compact quotient stage selected by the already proved discriminant tail
height. -/
def discriminantHardQuotientStage (N : ℕ) : Set GammaTwoQuotient :=
  gammaTwoQuotientMk ''
    gammaTwoThreeCuspTruncation (discriminantLiteralCuspLevel N)

/-- All representatives of the compact quotient stage in the selected
closed carrier. -/
def discriminantHardCarrierLift (N : ℕ) : Set ℍ :=
  gammaTwoClosedTileCarrier ∩
    gammaTwoQuotientMk ⁻¹' discriminantHardQuotientStage N

/-- One literal stage containing every selected-carrier representative of

/-! ##### Hard and complementary physical weights -/

/-- Hard discriminant weight on the literal stage. -/
noncomputable def discriminantHardStageWeight
    (N : ℕ) (z : ℍ) : ℂ :=
  if gammaTwoQuotientMk z ∈ discriminantHardQuotientStage N then
    (upstairsPotential z : ℂ)
  else 0

/-- Complementary carrier weight. -/
noncomputable def discriminantTailCarrierWeight
    (N : ℕ) (z : ℍ) : ℂ :=
  if gammaTwoQuotientMk z ∈ discriminantHardQuotientStage N then
    0
  else (upstairsPotential z : ℂ)

/-- The untruncated carrier weight. -/
noncomputable def discriminantFullCarrierWeight (z : ℍ) : ℂ :=
  (upstairsPotential z : ℂ)

/-! ### P11.5: an actual fixed-window lower-activity theorem -/

/-- Discrete spectral mass supplied by the positive real-axis Gaussian. -/

  Real.exp (-a * (m : ℝ) ^ 2)

  discreteGaussianSpectralMass_uniform_on_Iic ha N

/-! ### P11.6: explicit profiles and an actual crossover -/

/-- A concrete positive lower profile. -/
def explicitLowerProfile (_m : ℕ) : ℝ := 2

/-- A concrete decaying upper profile. -/
def explicitUpperProfile (m : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)

/-- Every natural index is admissible for this numerical comparison. -/
def explicitCrossoverIndices : Set ℕ := Set.univ

declarations.name: exists_explicitProfile_crossover
declarations.header:

    ∃ m ∈ explicitCrossoverIndices,

declarations.name: no_statistic_between_explicitProfiles
declarations.header:
theorem no_statistic_between_explicitProfiles :
    ¬ ∃ S : ℕ → ℝ,
      (∀ m ∈ explicitCrossoverIndices, explicitLowerProfile m ≤ S m) ∧
      (∀ m, |S m| ≤ explicitUpperProfile m):=

declarations.name: explicitProfiles_crossover_component
declarations.header:
theorem explicitProfiles_crossover_component :
    ∃ m ∈ explicitCrossoverIndices,
      explicitUpperProfile m < explicitLowerProfile m :=
  exists_explicitProfile_crossover

/-!
## P6--P8/P12: unconditional scalar-discriminant Fredholm endpoint

Append this section after
`P5DiscriminantHardTruncation.graphPotentialOperator_isCompact_unconditional`.
It removes the last compactness argument from the actual modular PDE API.
-/

namespace Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.AutomorphicSobolev
namespace ActualScalarDiscriminantPDE

open ComplexLaxMilgram FredholmBypass
open ExplicitDiscriminantPotential.FixedPhaseGraphPotential

/-- P5 compactness, re-exported at the exact weak PDE type. -/

declarations.name: actualScalarPotential_isCompact
declarations.header:
theorem actualScalarPotential_isCompact (n : ℤ) :
    IsCompactOperator (graphPotentialOperator n) :=
  P5DiscriminantHardTruncation.graphPotentialOperator_isCompact_unconditional n

/-- The actual shifted decomposition now has no analytic premise. -/
noncomputable def unconditionalShiftedCompactDecomposition
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) :
    ShiftedCompactDecomposition (weakSchrodingerOperator n t) :=
  shiftedCompactDecomposition_of_compactPotential n t
    (actualScalarPotential_isCompact n)

/-- The full nontrivial-kernel Fredholm package for the concrete modular
scalar-potential equation, with no compactness certificate argument. -/
noncomputable def unconditionalFredholmData
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) :
    NontrivialKernelFredholmData (weakSchrodingerOperator n t) :=
  fredholmData_of_compactPotential n t
    (actualScalarPotential_isCompact n)

/-- Boundedness is the literal continuous-linear-map estimate. -/

declarations.name: weakSchrodingerOperator_norm_le
declarations.header:
theorem weakSchrodingerOperator_norm_le
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) (u : ActualHOne n) :
    ‖weakSchrodingerOperator n t u‖ ≤
      ‖weakSchrodingerOperator n t‖ * ‖u‖ :=
  (weakSchrodingerOperator n t).le_opNorm u

/-- Closed range for the actual unshifted equation. -/

declarations.name: weakSchrodinger_range_isClosed
declarations.header:
theorem weakSchrodinger_range_isClosed
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) :
    IsClosed ((weakSchrodingerOperator n t).range :
      Set (ActualHMinusOne n)) :=
  (unconditionalFredholmData n t).range_isClosed

/-- Exact range/cokernel identity. -/

declarations.name: weakSchrodinger_range_eq_orthogonal_adjointKernel
declarations.header:
theorem weakSchrodinger_range_eq_orthogonal_adjointKernel
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) :
    (weakSchrodingerOperator n t).range =
      (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint
        (weakSchrodingerOperator n t)).kerᗮ :=
  (unconditionalFredholmData n t).range_eq_orthogonal_adjointKernel

/-- The homogeneous solution space is finite-dimensional. -/

declarations.name: weakSchrodinger_kernel_finiteDimensional
declarations.header:
theorem weakSchrodinger_kernel_finiteDimensional
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) :
    FiniteDimensional ℂ (weakSchrodingerOperator n t).ker :=
  weakSchrodinger_kernel_finiteDimensional_of_compactPotential n t
    (actualScalarPotential_isCompact n)

/-- The compatibility obstruction space is finite-dimensional. -/

declarations.name: weakSchrodinger_adjointKernel_finiteDimensional
declarations.header:
theorem weakSchrodinger_adjointKernel_finiteDimensional
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) :
    FiniteDimensional ℂ
      (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint
        (weakSchrodingerOperator n t)).ker :=
  weakSchrodinger_adjointKernel_finiteDimensional_of_compactPotential n t
    (actualScalarPotential_isCompact n)

/-- The algebraic quotient cokernel is finite-dimensional. -/

declarations.name: weakSchrodinger_cokernel_finiteDimensional
declarations.header:
theorem weakSchrodinger_cokernel_finiteDimensional
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) :
    FiniteDimensional ℂ
      (ShiftedCompactDecomposition.FredholmCokernel
        (weakSchrodingerOperator n t)) :=
  weakSchrodinger_cokernel_finiteDimensional_of_compactPotential n t
    (actualScalarPotential_isCompact n)

/-- Exact compatibility condition for arbitrary anti-dual forcing. -/

declarations.name: weakSchrodinger_solvable_iff_adjointKernel_orthogonal_unconditional
declarations.header:
theorem weakSchrodinger_solvable_iff_adjointKernel_orthogonal_unconditional
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) (f : ActualHMinusOne n) :
    (∃ u : ActualHOne n, weakSchrodingerOperator n t u = f) ↔
      f ∈ (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint
        (weakSchrodingerOperator n t)).kerᗮ :=
  (unconditionalFredholmData n t)
    .solvable_iff_mem_orthogonal_adjointKernel f

/-- Pointwise form of the same compatibility condition. -/

declarations.name: weakSchrodinger_solvable_iff_forall_adjointKernel_inner_eq_zero
declarations.header:
theorem weakSchrodinger_solvable_iff_forall_adjointKernel_inner_eq_zero
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) (f : ActualHMinusOne n) :
    (∃ u : ActualHOne n, weakSchrodingerOperator n t u = f) ↔
      ∀ w : ActualHMinusOne n,
        ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (weakSchrodingerOperator n t) w = 0 →
          inner ℂ w f = 0 :=
  (unconditionalFredholmData n t)
    .solvable_iff_forall_adjointKernel_inner_eq_zero f

/-- Canonical kernel-orthogonal solution, now with no compactness argument. -/
noncomputable def unconditionalCanonicalWeakSolution
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) (f : CompatibleForcing n t) :
    ActualHOne n :=
  (unconditionalFredholmData n t).canonicalSolution f

@[simp]

declarations.name: unconditionalCanonicalWeakSolution_spec
declarations.header:
theorem unconditionalCanonicalWeakSolution_spec
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) (f : CompatibleForcing n t) :
    weakSchrodingerOperator n t
      (unconditionalCanonicalWeakSolution n t f) =
        (f : ActualHMinusOne n) :=
  (unconditionalFredholmData n t).canonicalSolution_spec f

declarations.name: unconditionalCanonicalWeakSolution_mem_kernelOrthogonal
declarations.header:
theorem unconditionalCanonicalWeakSolution_mem_kernelOrthogonal
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) (f : CompatibleForcing n t) :
    unconditionalCanonicalWeakSolution n t f ∈
      (weakSchrodingerOperator n t).kerᗮ :=
  (unconditionalFredholmData n t)
    .canonicalSolution_mem_kernelOrthogonal f

/-- Every solution is the canonical solution plus precisely one arbitrary
homogeneous kernel vector. -/

declarations.name: weakSchrodinger_solves_iff_unconditionalCanonical_add_kernel
declarations.header:
theorem weakSchrodinger_solves_iff_unconditionalCanonical_add_kernel
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) (f : CompatibleForcing n t)
    (u : ActualHOne n) :
    weakSchrodingerOperator n t u = (f : ActualHMinusOne n) ↔
      ∃ h : ActualHOne n,
        h ∈ (weakSchrodingerOperator n t).ker ∧
          u = unconditionalCanonicalWeakSolution n t f + h :=
  (unconditionalFredholmData n t).solves_iff_canonical_add_kernel f u

/-- The true unshifted reduced inverse constant. -/
noncomputable def unconditionalReducedInverseNorm
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (unconditionalFredholmData n t).canonicalInverseNorm

declarations.name: unconditionalReducedInverseNorm_nonneg
declarations.header:
theorem unconditionalReducedInverseNorm_nonneg
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ unconditionalReducedInverseNorm n t :=
  (unconditionalFredholmData n t).canonicalInverseNorm_nonneg

declarations.name: unconditionalCanonicalWeakSolution_norm_le
declarations.header:
theorem unconditionalCanonicalWeakSolution_norm_le
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) (f : CompatibleForcing n t) :
    ‖unconditionalCanonicalWeakSolution n t f‖ ≤
      unconditionalReducedInverseNorm n t * ‖f‖ :=
  (unconditionalFredholmData n t).canonicalSolution_norm_le f

/-! #### Kernel-trivial specialization -/

/-- If a separate theorem proves that the actual homogeneous equation has no
nonzero solution, the same compact decomposition produces the genuine
unshifted continuous equivalence.  Kernel triviality is not fabricated here. -/
noncomputable def trivialKernelFredholmData
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ)
    (hker : HasTrivialKernel (weakSchrodingerOperator n t)) :
    FredholmBypassData (weakSchrodingerOperator n t) where

declarations.name: weakSchrodingerEquiv_of_trivialKernel_apply
declarations.header:

/-!
## P10/P11: manuscript correction and honest dependency audit

This fragment is appended after `P11ActualSpectralFoundations`.  It has two
purposes.

* It strengthens the arithmetic layer with an explicit reduced-residue
  half-step phase sum.  Every estimate proved for it is a finite-sum or
  summability theorem from the imported Mathlib API.
* It records the exact dependency boundary of the spectral argument as data,
  not as an analytic certificate.  In particular, no value of the audit data
  is an Eisenstein expansion, a Plancherel theorem, a Kuznetsov formula, or a
  Weil estimate, and no theorem below constructs one.

The endpoint combines the manuscript correction firewall with a model showing
that all currently discharged Gaussian/finite-arithmetic facts coexist with
valid lower and upper estimates having no crossover.  Thus those facts cannot
silently manufacture the missing spectral and arithmetic inputs.
-/

namespace Mock2FA.PaperCorrections.P10P11HonestDependencyAudit

/-! ### Exact smooth-core / elliptic-regularity dependency boundary -/

/-- The maximal distributional realization is self-adjoint exactly when the
minimal graph closure reaches the maximal operator.  This is a direct use of
Mathlib's `LinearPMap.isSelfAdjoint_def` and the already proved double-adjoint
identity, not an elliptic-regularity assumption. -/

declarations.name: maximalStrongSchrodinger_isSelfAdjoint_iff_minimal_eq_maximal
declarations.header:

    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) :
    IsSelfAdjoint (maximalStrongSchrodinger n t) ↔
      (minimalStrongSchrodinger n t).closure =
        maximalStrongSchrodinger n t:=

declarations.name: smoothCoreIsOperatorCore_iff_maximal_isSelfAdjoint
declarations.header:
theorem smoothCoreIsOperatorCore_iff_maximal_isSelfAdjoint
    (n : ℤ) (t : ℝ) :
    SmoothCoreIsOperatorCore n t ↔
      IsSelfAdjoint (maximalStrongSchrodinger n t) :=
  (smoothCore_operatorCore_iff_minimal_eq_maximal n t).trans
    (maximalStrongSchrodinger_isSelfAdjoint_iff_minimal_eq_maximal n t).symm

/-- Equality of the self-adjoint form realization with the maximal
distributional realization is the same missing operator-core theorem. -/

declarations.name: modularAssociatedOperator_eq_maximal_iff_smoothCoreIsOperatorCore
declarations.header:
theorem modularAssociatedOperator_eq_maximal_iff_smoothCoreIsOperatorCore

/-!
This fragment is intended after
`P3_Reduced_Chart_Periodization_Closure_Fragment.lean`,
`P3_Reduced_Chart_L2_Descent_Closure_Fragment.lean`, and the
Bochner/pointwise bridge.

It proves the quotient-to-planar weak-graph bridge on a whole reduced chart.
The proof does not cut a chosen polygon along a paired side.  Instead it uses
the completed fundamental carrier containing the chart, periodizes the
complex-conjugate test, applies the defining Hilbert-adjoint identity, and
then conjugates the exact Hermitian pairing.  Every sign and every
weight-dependent zeroth-order coefficient is retained.
-/
